jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Harmless Harvest envisions a world where nutritious, clean, organic and healthy food and beverages are the standard rather than the exception; where all people involved in creating the product are treated with fairness; and the planet is treated harmlessly. We are focused on changing the world, and we are always looking for like\-minded, wildly passionate individuals to help us to do this.

**About the Role:**


The Accounts Manager will exhibit eagerness to learn the true ins and outs of account management – both internal and external facing. Qualified candidates should have a deep aspiration to grow and develop their regional/national accounts and the overall Harmless Harvest business. The ideal candidate is a team\-player, willing to get their hands dirty, is passionate to paint the streets green \& white, and is a selling machine!


The Accounts Manager is responsible for managing regional chain accounts and independents ranging from $10K to over $250K in annual revenue and managing brokers and distributors to maximize all opportunities to drive sales and profit growth in the Natural channel.




**What you’ll be doing:**

* Develop and deliver impactful customer presentations, business reviews, and strategic promotional plans to positively shape customer strategy and provide insights \& solutions for profitable growth
* Identify, prioritize, pursue, secure and scale business with new customers, to deliver Annual Operating Plan (AOP) objectives (nets sales and profit)
* Effectively manage and grow existing business with your key customers, accelerating both top and bottom line
* Utilize data sources to analyze and capitalize on sales opportunities
* Serve as a point person in understanding and identifying market sales trends for your accounts using syndicated data
* Deliver/exceed established sales targets and quotas on time and within trade budget parameters
* Develop and execute situation assessments, objectives, strategies and execution plans for targeted accounts
* Possess a strong working understanding of each customer's strategy, organization, Marketing/R\&D, and decision\-making process
* Manage direct communication and strategy with local distributors/brokers and field sales reps
* Work cross functionally internally with marketing, innovation, demand planning teams, etc. and externally to maximize selling efforts and achieve business objectives




**What you’ll bring:**

* Bachelor’s Degree preferred
* Minimum 1\-3 years of experience in CPG sales across MULO \&/or Natural channel
* Minimum 1\-2 years in direct customer management
* Proficient with MS Office Suite (Excel, PPT, Word, Outlook, Teams, etc), SPINS or comparable syndicated data source, Vividly or comparable trade tool management
* Must have a strong understanding and experience with basic trade math, consumption data, trade spend, sales reports, promo spend and funding, demand planning, presentation building and presenting, etc.
* Must possess excellent written and verbal communication skills, ability to foster new relationships, active listening to understand team and customer needs
* Strong analytical skills with ability to identify trends in sales data
* Strong organizational and time management skills, comfort with fast\-paced sales environment and problem solving
* Team player mentality, willingness to collaborate with team members and work cross\-functionally
* Background in perishable products is a plus




**Benefits:**

* Competitive Compensation (Base Salary \& Bonus)
* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental, \& Vision)
* Retirement Plan (Traditional 401k \& Roth 401k)
* Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary, AD\&D)
* Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick, Public Holidays)
* Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
* Short Term \& Long Term Disability




* The salary range for this role may vary above or below the posted range as determined by location. This range has not been adjusted for any specific geographic differential applicable by area where the position may be filled. Compensation takes into account several factors including but not limited to a candidate’s experience, education, skills, relevant certifications, department equity, training and organizational needs. Base pay is just one piece of the total rewards program offered by Harmless Harvest which includes comprehensive perks and health benefits.


At Harmless Harvest, we embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion as catalysts for innovation and success. We are dedicated to fostering a team with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, believing that this enriches our creativity and strengthens our service to customers and communities alike.


Harmless Harvest is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at Harmless Harvest via\-email, the Internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of Harmless Harvest. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Harmless Harvest as a result of the referral or through other means.

jobs.description:
**Account Manager**
===================

  

**Date:** Sep 15, 2026


**Location:** San Jose, California, United States


**Company:** Super Micro Computer


**Job Req ID: 30276**
---------------------


**About Supermicro:**
---------------------


Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. We are the \#5 fastest growing company among the Silicon Valley Top 50 technology firms. Our unprecedented global expansion has provided us with the opportunity to offer a large number of new positions to the technology community. We seek talented, passionate, and committed engineers, technologists, and business leaders to join us.  

  



**Job Summary:**
----------------


Supermicro Computer is looking for an Account Manager who has experience with selling technical solutions and developing business. The ideal candidate must also have a proven track record in winning enterprise level relationships and consistently achieving and exceeding assigned sales quotas.


**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
------------------------------------------


* Manage products through their entire lifecycle until product EOL


* Develop strategic sales goals with exceptional execution to meet the sales target


* Qualify leads and creating target lists of enterprise or data center accounts


* Seek potential customers (e.g., Corporate Customers, Value\-Added Resellers, OEMs) through cold calling and follow\-up customer visits


* Participate in marketing activities such as trade shows to generate leads


* Ability to strategically positioned Supermicro’s products and services in the market


* Develop customer relationships and maintain/manage accounts, expand existing client accounts for retention and potential growth


* Work with cross functional teams to draft and negotiate various types of contracts


* Manage day\-to\-day sales operations


* Negotiate sales pricing, monitoring orders, facilitating credit issues and negotiating sales returns


**Qualifications:**
-------------------


* Bachelor degree in business, engineering or similar fields preferred
* 1\-2 years of hands\-on experience with selling computer hardware solutions to data center or enterprise accounts (prior software or telecom sales will be considered) preferred
* Successful track record with credible cold calling and follow\-up with key decision makers
* Ability to thrive both independently and in a team environment
* Demonstrated ability in the following areas: pre\-call planning, opportunity qualification and objection handling, call structure and control, time and territory management
* Strong persuasive and negotiating skills; Ability to polished words in verbal, written, and presentation
* Extremely proactive, highly organized, with proven ability to manage multiple tasks
* Exceptional management skill in time and territory


**Salary Range**
----------------


$72,500 \- $104,000


The salary offered will depend on several factors, including your location, level, education, training, specific skills, years of experience, and comparison to other employees already in this role. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation, such as participation in bonus and equity award programs.

-----------------

jobs.description:
Additional Job Description**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**


 This is an exciting opportunity with CoolIT Systems, the leading provider of scalable liquid cooling technology, as a Key Account Manager (hunter focused) for targeted cloud service provider/Hyperscaler customers. In this role, you will be expected to aggressively identify, pursue, and win strategic opportunities, expand wallet share, and convert high\-value prospects into long\-term customers. Join our rapidly growing organization and make an impact in the data center industry by driving new business growth and accelerating market penetration.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Own the development and execution of a territory and account strategy focused on hunting, penetrating, and winning 1\-3 named hyperscale liquid cooling customers or prospects.
* Understand client needs and our competitive positioning, challenges, and goals to offer tailored solutions for their cooling requirements to enable growth in sales.
* Act as the primary commercial lead for target accounts, driving outbound engagement, uncovering opportunities early, qualifying demand, and advancing prospects through the sales cycle to close.
* Consistently build, progress, and close a high\-quality pipeline that meets or exceeds CoolIT's program pipeline, bookings, and forecast targets.
* Lead review and negotiation of customer contracts and manage inputs from stakeholders to drive execution of contracts.
* Develop and execute account penetration plans that create double\-digit revenue growth through new program wins, competitive displacement, and expansion into adjacent opportunities.
* Demonstrate technical expertise in data center operations and cooling solutions.
* Collaborate internally with Operations to ensure successful project execution from initial discussions to delivery and implementation.
* Maintain a sharp point of view on industry trends, competitor moves, whitespace opportunities, and customer buying triggers to inform pursuit strategy.
* Provide market insights and voice of customer feedback to guide product development and innovation.
* Continuously monitor performance metrics and quality standards, driving continuous improvement initiatives as needed.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.
* Potential for travel up to 40% domestically and up to 25% internationally.

**WHO YOU ARE:**

**Basic Qualifications:**


* 8\+ years of experience in business development, strategic sales, or account management, with a strong preference for candidates who have excelled in hunter\-oriented roles.
* 4\+ years of experience working in a manufacturing or advanced technology business.
* Bachelor degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* Proven track record of winning complex enterprise sales in a sales\-led organization, including originating opportunities, shaping deals, and closing with Fortune 50 clients.
* Demonstrated experience with the big 5 Cloud Service Providers.
* Strong commercial instincts with a bias for action, persistence, and accountability in pursuing revenue and customer outcomes.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* Legally authorized to work in (Country) without company sponsorship.

**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Preference for strong technical background, with experience in data center infrastructure, cooling systems, or related fields.
* Experience using CRM and ERP systems such as Oracle Netsuite (preferred), SAP, Salesforce, or ServiceNow.

**Skills:**


* Strategic hunter mindset with a demonstrated ability to open doors, build pursuit plans, navigate complex stakeholder environments, and win high\-value business.
* Strong organizational and analytical skills; ability to work effectively under time constraints and deliver results by critical deadlines.
* Excellent leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate teams across all levels of the organization.
* High drive, resilience, and urgency, with the ability to adapt quickly, overcome obstacles, and maintain momentum in competitive sales cycles.

  



**WHY COOLIT?**


We strive to be an employer of choice and as such we believe in rewarding our employees with career and development opportunities that will maintain and strengthen our culture while aligning to our vision and values.


We are a company that is full of vibrant, innovative people who love what we do. Our comprehensive benefits package includes:

* Vacation and flex days, and paid company\-wide shutdown during the holiday season.
* Comprehensive benefits including Dental, Drugs, Optical, Paramedical and Health Spending. These costs are covered by CoolIT and are enacted from your first day.
* Dress for your day – in a casual yet professional environment.
* Retention rewards like “The Big Coffee Break” that reward tenure with additional vacation time and a monetary bonus.
* Company\-funded RRSP contributions to support your long\-term financial goals.


We thank every candidate in advance, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted. Successful candidates for this position will be required to undergo background checks including criminal records check and education.

**About CoolIT, An Ecolab Company**


Founded in Calgary, Alberta in 2001, CoolIT Systems is the leading Direct Liquid Cooling technology provider for data centers, supercomputers, and desktop computers. We design and manufacture solutions used by the largest tech companies globally.


Recognized as one of “The Americas’ Fastest Growing Companies 2023” by Financial Times and honored with the Deloitte Fast 50 Clean Technology award in 2022, as well as the Deloitte Fast 500 distinction in both 2021 and 2022, CoolIT's rapid growth is capturing global attention.


As demand for generative AI, high performance computing and cloud solutions rapidly expands, there has never been a more exciting time to join our team.

jobs.title: Account Manager – CSP & ODM/CM Accounts
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

JPC Connectivity is seeking an energetic, proactive, and detail\-oriented Associate Account Manager to join our Silicon Valley team in Milpitas, CA. This position is a high\-growth career runway designed for early\-career professionals or ambitious entry\-level talent eager to build a career in the high\-speed data center, server, and cloud infrastructure industries. In this role, you will serve as a key commercial and operational bridge connecting top\-tier Cloud Service Providers (CSPs), Taiwanese Original Design Manufacturers (ODMs), Contract Manufacturers (CMs), and JPC’s global engineering and manufacturing teams in Taiwan. You will be coached to manage accounts end\-to\-end—driving project execution from early\-stage New Product Introduction (NPI) into high\-volume Mass Production (MP), maintaining strong customer rapport, and identifying new hardware design\-win opportunities.

**Key Responsibilities** 

**1\. Account Coordination \& Ecosystem Management**

● Serve as Primary Liaison: Act as the daily operational point of contact for assigned CSP procurement teams and their tier\-1 ODM/CM partners (e.g., Foxconn, Quanta, Wiwynn, Inventec).

● Relationship Building: Develop and nurture professional networks across customer procurement, engineering, program management, and supply chain departments.

● Customer Support: Track day\-to\-day customer requests, sample orders, open action items, and technical queries to ensure rapid turnaround times and complete execution.

**2\. NPI\-to\-Mass Production Project Orchestration**

● Lifecycle Tracking: Monitor engineering programs across early architecture phase, sample builds, qualification (EVT/DVT/PVT stages), and smooth transition into mass production (MP).

● Cross\-Functional Alignment: Work closely with customer project managers and internal quality, engineering, and factory leads to resolve engineering change orders (ECOs), quality inquiries, and delivery bottlenecks.

● Demand Pull\-Through: Ensure design approvals at the CSP architectural level accurately translate into production orders and forecast allocations at ODM/CM assembly sites.

**3\. Cross\-Regional Collaboration (US–Taiwan Bridge)**

● HQ \& Factory Engagement: Maintain daily communication with JPC’s Taiwan account management, engineering, and manufacturing teams to align project timelines, cost targets, and product specifications.

● Time\-Zone Agility: Participate in periodic evening coordination calls with Taiwan teams to accelerate urgent project requirements and address global time\-zone differences.

**4\. Commercial \& Business Operations**

● RFQ \& Quotation Support: Coordinate quotation requests (RFQs), gather cost structures from Taiwan engineering, calculate pricing margins, and deliver polished commercial proposals.

● Documentation \& Reporting: Maintain accurate program trackers, revenue forecasts, CRM records, meeting minutes, and executive account summaries.

● Account Expansion: Learn JPC’s technology portfolio (High\-Speed DAC/AEC, Optical Transceivers, Power Connectors, Custom Harnesses) to proactively identify cross\-selling opportunities within existing customer platforms.

Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Cloud Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.

jobs.title: Field Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Join an elite group of sales professionals bringing customized, white glove experiences directly in the customer’s home. Field Sales Representatives at AT\&T are driven to connect – every interaction is an opportunity to introduce the latest technology and services, thriving on the challenge to make your sales goals happen. With uncapped commission potential, your career and the rewards that come with it are within reach. Enjoy uncapped commission potential as a Field Sales Representative, with top earners having the opportunity to make $100,000\.


Our new Field Sales Representatives earn between $62,900 to $100,000, including the salary and our uncapped commission opportunities. Individual starting salary within this range may depend on geography, experience, expertise, and education/training. Salary range is dependent on if all sales goals are met and/or exceeded.


You’ll be the face and voice of AT\&T to your customers, working independently to deliver personalized sales interactions at scheduled appointments provided to you. You’ll close the deal by offering hands\-on demos, Wi\-Fi assessments, tech delivery and issue resolutions \- keeping customers connected to what matters most to them.

**How you get the job done:**

* We’ll kick things off with paid training –setting you up for success to work independently in the field. Coaching, mentoring and ongoing learning opportunities will keep you on track and tech\-savvy
* You’ll connect with our existing customers daily. AT\&T will provide scheduled appointments, giving you the opportunity to engage with warm prospects effectively.
* You’ll use strong negotiation and communications skills – you know how to make a smooth pivot, and are highly motivated to get it right and make the sale

**Key expectations to succeed:**

* **1\+ years of commission sales and outside sales experience highly preferred**
* Demonstrated success in commission sales and achieving sales targets
* Proficient in upselling techniques that enhance customer value and satisfaction
* Strong verbal communication skills with an ability to build rapport quickly
* Maintain a valid driver’s license—be ready to drive, as we provide a company vehicle for **official business use only**
* Work a varied schedule designed to meet customers on their timeline –this includes evenings, weekends, and holidays
* Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, including drug screening, criminal history, and motor vehicle record


If you are considering jobs like Direct Sales Representative, Residential Sales Representative, Territory Sales Representative or Field Sales Executive – Home Solutions, this career move would be a great fit!

**Joining our team comes with amazing perks and benefits:**

* Medical/Dental/Vision coverage
* 401(k) plan
* Tuition reimbursement program
* Paid Time off and holidays (With some exceptions, bargained employees qualify for one week of PTO after 6 months of service and 2 weeks after the first year). At least 6 company designated holidays and additional PTO (based on bargaining group to which you are hired.
* Sick leave
* Paid Parental Leave
* Adoption Reimbursement
* Disability Benefits (short term and long term)
* Life and Accidental Death Insurance
* Supplemental benefit programs: critical illness, accident hospital indemnity/group legal
* Employee Assistance Programs (EAP)
* Employee discounts up to 50% off on eligible AT\&T mobility plans and accessories, AT\&T internet (and fiber where available) and AT\&T phone
* A company paid device and service plan, giving you first\-hand expertise with our latest technology.


Candidates with arrest or convictions records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiatives for Hiring Ordinance, and the California Fair Chance Act.


Relevant Material Job Duties for which Criminal History may have a direct adverse, and negative relationship potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the Conditional Offer of Employment

jobs.title: Technical Community Manager
jobs.description:
### **About The Role**



Together AI is the AI native cloud, which has been built bottoms up to cater to the demand for the new generation of AI applications and agents. The company has seen tremendous growth with 10X growth year on year and has over a million developers.



As we continue to scale the company, we continue to see strong community engagement \- with developers looking at Together AI not just as an inference platform but also as a go\-to place for all things related to open source AI.This newly created role will lead the charter for community engagement, being the advocate for our technical audience and making sure they get what they need to successful, whether they are current users or prospective customers. They will own our X, LinkedIn and Discord channels, and set the strategy for community engagement and growth. They will work across technical teams internally to develop content and other materials to deliver on that strategy.


### **Responsibilities**


* Be the heartbeat of the Together AI technical community \- understanding the developers and researchers who follow us and enabling them to be successful
* Operate our community handles across X, Linkedin and Discord
* Own content strategy for these handles, delivering engaging content that the community cares about, across learning content, user content and more
* Collaborate across marketing, developer relations and solution architect teams to deliver on the content strategy
* Experiment and test new ideas to see what resonates with the community \- including new content types, competitions and swag
* While the role involved mainly online engagement (80%), there is an aspect of translating their deep understanding to deliver highly engaging in\-person meet ups and events (20%) in collaboration with Events/ Dev\-rel teams

### **Requirements**


* 3\+ years of developer marketing and community engagement experience
* Deep understanding of the AI developer audience
* Keenly aware of social spaces that developers operate in, and ideally, they themselves operate in those spaces on X
* Naturally inclined towards social presence, always keeping a pulse on what’s happening in the developer world
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to build something from ground up
* Data\-driven and ideas person \- always thinking of new experiments and content
* Ideally a developer themselves with an engineering background

### **About Together AI**



Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose\-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high\-performance inference that scales reliably, reinforcement learning to create specialized models, and pre\-training for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves over 400 trillion tokens a month.


### **Compensation**



We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance and other competitive benefits. The US base salary range for this full\-time position is: $200K\-230K \+ equity \+ benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job\-related knowledge. This is a hybrid role based in the Bay Area.


### **Equal Opportunity**



Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.



Please see our privacy policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
At Coram AI, we’re reimagining video security for the modern world. Our cloud\-native platform uses computer vision and AI to help businesses stay safe, make smarter decisions, and move faster; from real\-time alerts to seamless clip sharing and multi\-site visibility.


You’ll be joining an ambitious, fast\-moving team that values clarity, craftsmanship, and impact. Every person here has a voice, ships meaningful work, and helps shape how AI can make the world safer and more connected.

**The role:**


Coram AI is hiring for our next cohort of Business Development Representatives to join our growing sales team. This is an entry\-level technology sales role designed for ambitious early\-career professionals looking to build a career in AI, SaaS, and B2B sales.

  

Our accelerated BDR program combines the best parts of a Business Development Representative (BDR), Marketing Development Representative (MDR), and Account Executive role. You'll work directly with experienced Account Executives on live deals, build and own pipeline through outbound prospecting, develop your sales skills, and work toward promotion into a full\-cycle Account Executive role within 6 months, compared with the traditional 1–2 year SDR\-to\-AE path. You'll learn how to prospect, qualify opportunities, run sales conversations, build pipeline, and sell Coram AI's physical security platform to businesses across the U.S.

  

Our second Fall 2026 cohort will start on November 2nd.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Build and qualify pipeline through targeted, strategic prospecting
* Partner with senior AEs on live deals, from discovery to close
* Participate in and help deliver product demos to prospects and partners
* Understand and uncover customer needs and business problems to effectively communicate how Coram can solve them
* Master Coram’s platform and learn how to sell value
* Consistently outperform assigned goals and earn your promotion to a full\-cycle Account Executive title
* Ability to understand complex business environments and uncover customer issues, process problems, and translate need into business opportunities.

 **Skills and qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Associate's degree, or relevant working experience
* We’re especially interested in college athletes and others with highly competitive backgrounds (military, performing arts, debate, high‑level competition, entrepreneurship, etc.) but this is not a requirement to apply
* A strong work ethic with a focus on winning the right way
* Motivation to win and a willingness to out‑prepare and out‑work your competition
* Intrinsically\-driven with the ability to takes initiative by default
* Coachable and curious mindset with the ability to ask questions, take feedback, and apply it to your work
* Resilient in challenging and fast\-paced environments
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English
* Ability to work in an onsite environment

 **What we offer:**

* Competitive compensation package which includes annual base salary of $60,000 \+ variable compensation of $10,000
* Clear promotion path from Associate Account Executive to full\-cycle Account Executive within 6 months
* Opportunity to relocate into any of our US offices (SLC, AZ, NYC, or ATL)
* Flexible paid time off and 10 paid holidays
* Daily team breakfast and dinner, and regular team off\-sites
* The latest Apple products and unlimited tech stack (Claude, Nooks, Clay, Instantly, etc.)
* Free onsite EV charging \+ commuter stipend
* 100% Employer\-paid medical, dental, vision, and base life insurance
* 401(k) with both Traditional and Roth options
* Early\-stage equity in a rapidly growing company
* Referral bonuses

  

We're on a mission to transform a $50B\+ legacy industry by bringing the power of cutting\-edge multimodal LLMs and computer vision to real\-world security and operations. From firearm detection to intelligent access control, our AI\-native platform turns every camera and sensor into a smart system that enhances safety, efficiency, and awareness.


Founded by Ashesh Jain (ex\-Lyft Level 5, PhD Cornell) and Peter Ondruska (ex\-Lyft, PhD Oxford), Coram AI is backed by Ansa Capital, Battery Ventures, Mosaic, 8VC and Up Partners, have raised over $65M, and were named to the CB Insights AI 100 as one of the most promising AI companies in the world. If you're excited to work on mission\-critical AI that makes an impact in the real world, we’d love to meet you.

* Proficient in CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) and comfortable navigating multiple channels with speed and precision

jobs.title: Executive Assistant (Hybrid, Sunnyvale)
jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission\-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

 **About the Role:**


CrowdStrike is looking for an Executive Assistant to support three VP\-level leaders across our global Engineering organization. This role provides administrative and operational support in a fast\-paced environment, partnering closely with Engineering teams and cross\-functional groups to keep leaders and their organizations running smoothly.


This is a hybrid role based in Sunnyvale, CA or Redmond, WA. Onsite presence of 2 days per week is required, with additional in\-office attendance to support executive meetings, onsites, and team events.

**What You'll Do:**

**Calendar and Meeting Management**

* Manage complex, high\-volume calendars in Google calendar across multiple time zones, resolving conflicts and reprioritizing as business needs shift sometimes without direction.
* Coordinate leadership team meetings, staff meetings, and department all\-hands — including agenda distribution, materials prep, notes, and action\-item follow\-up
* Follow up to ensure commitments and deliverables are met by others across the org

**Travel and Expense**

* Book and manage domestic and international travel, proactively adjusting for schedule changes and disruptions
* Brief leaders on relevant travel considerations — visas, currency, weather, and local logistics — and coordinate with Global Security on advisories where applicable
* Complete accurate, timely expense reconciliation and reporting in line with company policy
* Serve as an approval delegate for travel requests and expense reports on behalf of supported executives, applying company travel and expense policy and escalating exceptions or out\-of\-policy items to the executive or manager

**Events and Program Coordination**

* Plan and organize group activities and events for up to \~60 attendees without additional support, identifying who will do what and when, and monitoring progress and resource use
* Track meeting budgets, following approval workflows and coordinating with procurement teams, catering, activities, and travel logistics
* Coordinate logistics for recurring talent programs — annual performance review and mid\-year promotion cycles — including scheduling review sessions, communicating deadlines, and tracking documentation completeness in partnership with HR and Talent Acquisition

**Operational Support and Partnership**

* Take personal responsibility, with guidance from your manager, for well\-defined recurring projects such as weekly status reporting and onsite planning
* Identify and act on issues within your area of responsibility rather than waiting for escalation; try varied approaches and persist when difficulties arise
* Surface process friction points and improvement ideas to your manager and the broader EA team
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with EA peers, Engineering leaders, and cross\-functional partners; navigate ambiguity and help resolve scheduling and prioritization conflicts across teams
* Handle confidential and sensitive information with consistent discretion and sound judgment

**What You'll Need:**

* 2\+ years of executive administrative support experience, including direct support of senior leaders (Director level or above), or equivalent combination of experience and education
* Demonstrated experience booking and managing complex domestic and international travel, including multi\-leg itineraries, visa and documentation requirements, and real\-time rebooking during disruptions
* Demonstrated experience managing complex, high\-volume calendars across multiple time zones for multiple stakeholders
* Proficiency with Google Workspace — Gmail, Google Calendar, and Google Drive — is required
* Proficiency with Zoom and Slack is required
* Daily, hands\-on use of AI tools in your workflow — for example, drafting and editing communications, summarizing meetings and documents, researching travel and logistics, or preparing briefing materials — and enthusiasm for adopting new AI tooling as it becomes available
* Experience acting as an approval delegate for travel and expense workflows, with working knowledge of T\&E policy
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of the organization
* Exceptional attention to detail — reviews all relevant information before acting and proactively seeks review of your own work
* Proven ability to plan and coordinate group events and meetings independently
* Demonstrated discretion in handling confidential and proprietary information
* Ability to work onsite in Sunnyvale, CA or Redmond, WA on a hybrid schedule
* Willingness and ability to travel domestically with advance notice to support leader

**Job Description**

About the Agency:
  

  

The Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) oversees housing standards across all 3\.7 million homes in New York City.
  

  

As the nation’s largest municipal housing agency, HPD is responsible for building and preserving affordable housing, protecting tenants from harassment and displacement, and holding landlords accountable across the five boroughs. Under Commissioner Dina Levy and the Mamdani Administration, HPD is pursuing an ambitious housing agenda focused on the needs of New York’s tenants. With a broad set of tools including standards enforcement, tenant resources, and the creation of new affordable housing, HPD is committed to making New York City a more affordable place for renters and homeowners alike.
  

  

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  

  

Your Team:
  

The Office of Finance and Administration (OFA) leads the agency’s effort with the planning and management of the agency's resources and advises the Commissioner and senior team on how to improve efficiency and allocate funding to carry out HPD's mission. The financial segment of OFA is comprised of the Budget, Capital Planning, and Fiscal Affairs. These three divisions, work in conjunction to provide centralized support, consultation, and oversight on a broad range of financial issues for the entire agency.
  

  

At HPD, rental subsidy programs are managed by the Division of Tenant \& Owner Resources (DTOR) and Fiscal Affairs and are funded through local, state, and federal resources. HPD is also expanding its rental assistance offerings through new programs, including NYC 15/15, HOME TBRA, and HAVP.
  

  

Your Impact:
  

The Division of Fiscal Affairs is responsible for managing the agency’s accounts payable and accounts receivable operations, including Section 8 voucher payments and vendor registration for Development loans. The Central Administration Unit within Fiscal Affairs oversees the registration of vendors associated with Development loan programs.
  

Congress appropriated $5 billion in ARP funds to be administered through HOME\-American Rescue Plan (HOME\-ARP) to perform activities that must primarily benefit qualifying individuals and families who are homeless, at risk of homelessness, or in other vulnerable populations. These activities include: development and support of affordable housing, tenant\-based rental assistance (TBRA), provision of supportive services; and acquisition and development of non\-congregate shelter units. ARP defines qualifying individuals or families as those that are homeless, or at risk of homelessness, fleeing, or attempting to flee domestic violence, dating violence, sexual assault, stalking, or human trafficking; part of other populations where providing supportive services or assistance would prevent a family’s homelessness or would serve those with the greatest risk of housing instability; or veterans and families that include a veteran family member that meet the criteria previously stated.
  

  

The Central Administration Analyst will serve as a key W\-9 Liaison for the Department of Housing Access \& Stability (HAS) and Central Administration. In this role, the analyst will be responsible for registering all Section 8 and HOME\-ARP funded Development landlords in the City’s Financial Management System (FMS), ensuring accurate vendor onboarding and compliance with administrative requirements.  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

Your Role:
  

Your key responsibilities will include but not limited to the following:
  

  

Section 8 and HOME\-ARP Vendor Registration and Modification Activities
  

* Confirm documents submitted for vendor registration meet the threshold dictated by Comptroller issued Directive 29\.
* Verify that the vendor is not already registered in FMS and ensure vendor profile has been created in ELITE EMPHASYS.
* Conduct Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) verification by accessing the Internal Revenue Services website
* Create Initial Vendor Document or Modified Vendor Document in FMS, attach the requisite vendor verification documents. Submit for level 3 internal approval and then to the Vendor Validation Unit at the comptroller for Level 5 approval.
* Apply validation ELITE profile and maintain the various landlord validation spreadsheets.
* Complete all entries of activities in the Owner Services Database

  

Export Department Daily Financial Transaction Documents to the Financial Info. System Administrator (FISA)
  

* Perform the extraction of Micro Purchase Encumbrance Documents from HPD Info.
* Perform the extraction of the following types of vouchers from Microsoft Access database, Miscellaneous Payment Request (PRM1\), Commodity Payment Request (PRC2\) and Non\-Commodity Payment Request (PRN2\).
* Through access to the Remote Desktop Connection, uploads all encumbrances, vouchers, and cash receipt entries to the FISA inbound File Log.
* On the morning after the export activity, confirms that all files and documents are uploaded to FMS and are in the correct status.

* Determines the cause of each rejection and decide on the appropriate solution for voucher payment correction and the prevention of recurrence of said rejection.

Our programs provide wide accessibility to communities worldwide through a broad teacher and student network, prestigious resources, and a systematic, comprehensive and integrative approach to Pilates training. Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss \& Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We're a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future.


As a Wholesale Account Coordinator, you will be at the center of one of Levi's most important wholesale partnerships, helping bring products, strategies, and seasonal launches to life for the Macy's business. Working alongside Account Managers and cross\-functional partners, you'll drive order execution, support product launches, analyze business performance, and help solve challenges that impact the customer experience. You'll gain broad exposure across the wholesale business while contributing to a high\-profile account and learning from a collaborative team and manager committed to mentorship and development.

**About the Job**

* **Sales Support:** Partner with the Account Managers and sales team to execute account strategies, support seasonal business initiatives, and contribute to achieving sales and growth objectives.
* **Day\-to\-Day Account Management:** Maintain account documentation, manage item setup processes, support credit memo and claim resolution, and assist with key account activities including sell\-ins, business reviews, and go\-to\-market planning.
* **Order Management:** Manage order entry, planned unit maintenance, and purchase order tracking from placement through fulfillment. Partner with internal teams and retail customers to resolve order, inventory, delivery, and credit\-related issues while supporting on\-time and accurate product delivery.
* **Sample \& Product Management:** Own the end\-to\-end coordination of seasonal and in\-season samples, including ordering, tracking, inventory management, showroom readiness, and internal and external distribution.
* **Sales Analysis \& Reporting:** Prepare and maintain weekly, monthly, quarterly, and seasonal sales, shipping, and performance reports. Analyze business trends and provide insights that support account planning.
* **Cross\-Functional Partnership:** Collaborate with Planning, Merchandising, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Customer Service teams to support account objectives, resolve issues, and drive business execution.
* **Market \& Retail Insights:** Monitor retail trends, competitive activity, pricing, product placement, and in\-store execution to support account planning and identify opportunities within the marketplace.
* You will report to the Senior Account Manager, Macy's

**About You**

* **Relevant Experience:** 3\+ years of experience in wholesale, retail, merchandising, sales support, sales operations, customer operations, or a related consumer products environment.
* **Order \& Business Operations:** Experience supporting order management, purchase order processes, inventory coordination, account operations, or related business processes.
* **Analytical Mindset:** Ability to work with sales, inventory, shipping, or business performance data to identify trends, monitor results, and support decision\-making.
* **Collaborator:** Experience partnering with stakeholders across multiple functions to coordinate activities, resolve issues, and support business objectives.
* **Prioritization \& Execution:** Ability to manage competing priorities, follow established processes, and adapt to changing needs. Manage multiple deliverables that require accuracy, organization, and adherence to deadlines.
* **Technical Skills:** Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (ie utilizing functions such as Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP), data analysis tools and a basic understanding of retail math
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.


This is a hybrid work schedule based in our New York, New York office. You will be expected in office 3 days per week typically Tuesday\-Thursday. Note, time in office can vary depending on business needs.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Atlanta, GA, USA; Austin, TX, USA; New York, NY, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in a customer\-facing technical role.
* Experience with core cloud computing concepts and enterprise architecture principles, (e.g., networking, compute, storage, IT security, database systems, application development, operational frameworks).
* Experience presenting to technical and executive stakeholders (e.g., explaining technical concepts to non\-technical audiences).
* Experience supporting customers in cloud operations domains (e.g., launch/capacity planning, product release management, technical support, escalation management procedures).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* MBA or Master's degree in a Management, Technical, or Engineering field.
* Relevant technical professional certifications.
* Experience leading technical governance activities, such as establishing or actively participating in Architecture Review Boards (ARBs), or developing reference architectures and reusable patterns for an enterprise organization.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a Technical Success Account Manager (TSAM), you will serve as a strategic technical leader aligned with Google Cloud’s most critical customers. You will be responsible for driving sustained platform health, achieving technical excellence, and ensuring stability for key business critical workloads running on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will serve as the customer’s trusted technical advisor, translating complex business objectives into technical governance and modern, resilient cloud architectural strategies. You will advocate adoption of industry best practices and act as the primary point of accountability for resolving platform challenges and proactive risk mitigation, to the satisfaction of executive stakeholders.


This role requires independently forging strong executive relationships, advocating the implementation of Google Cloud architecture standards, elevating platform stability, and establishing technical accuracy across the customer’s GCP footprint, through a programmatic approach. Additionally, you will serve as the internal customer advocate, translating their strategic needs into actionable feedback for Google Cloud’s Product and Engineering teams, ensuring continuous service improvement and feature development.


Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $174000 \- $252000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits

--------------------

* Provide technical guidance and advocate the adoption of Google Cloud architecture and best practices via deep dives and workshops.
* Drive platform stability and excellence through deep architectural health assessments.
* Serve as the strategic technical advisor to address and resolve critical reliability concerns, advising on and guiding the architecture of highly robust, scalable, and resilient workloads.

jobs.description:
**OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY**


Fox Corporation
Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.**JOB DESCRIPTION**
-------------------


Red Seat Ventures partners with the world's top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content — through advertising, subscription, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our own proprietary tech stack including Supercast (subscription) and Speakeasy (hosting, distribution, and monetization).


Named after Ted Williams' longest home run at Fenway Park, RSV was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we're the fastest\-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.

**ABOUT OUR TEAM**


We’re a fast\-growing, fast\-moving media company at the forefront of podcast and video content. Our advertising partners range from major brands to exciting up\-and\-comers — and we help them connect with engaged, passionate audiences. If you’re curious about ad sales, love media, and thrive in fast\-paced environments, we want to hear from you.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**


We are seeking a detail\-oriented and client\-facing Account Manager to support campaigns across their full lifecycle—from pre\-sale pitch development through post\-sale reporting and client recaps.


In this role, you’ll partner closely with Account Executives and Sales Assistants during the pre\-sale process, then quarterback campaign kickoff and execution, and ultimately deliver clear, insightful wrap reporting to clients. You’ll have a front\-row seat to both sales and account management, making this an ideal role for someone looking to grow into a strategic, revenue\-facing position.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

*Pre\-Sale Collaboration*

* In partnership with Account Executives and Sales Assistants to develop pitch materials and proposals
* Build and refine client\-facing decks, ensuring strong storytelling and clear campaign positioning
* Support customization of campaigns based on client goals and objectives
* Gain exposure to deal strategy, packaging, and pricing considerations

 *Campaign Kickoff \& Execution*

* Lead campaign kickoffs, aligning internal teams and clients on timelines, deliverables, and expectations

**About Beside’s mission**
==========================


Beside is building an AI agent that helps small businesses grow, giving owners more time for their craft, their customers, and their lives.


We’re building for the people who run the real economy: the plumber between jobs, the family salon, the local gym owner. They started a business to do something they’re good at. But running it means wearing every hat: finding customers, answering calls, following up on quotes, booking appointments, and chasing payments. Every missed call or forgotten follow\-up can mean lost revenue.


Beside takes that work off their plate. We’re building a 24/7 agent that understands the business and takes action across the customer journey: helping it get found, turning inquiries into customers, and bringing those customers back. It connects the tools owners already use and moves work forward, with owners choosing what to delegate and what to approve.


Our foundation is Beside Phone. The phone is where our customers earn trust, understand what someone needs, and win business. Beside captures that context and connects it with email, calendars, websites, and the other tools the business runs on. That understanding lets the agent act on what matters.


We believe AI should give people more freedom to build a business on their own terms. More time for the work they care about. More attention for the people they serve. More room for creativity, connection, and the work only they can do.


That’s what we’re building.

  

**The Role**
============


We're hiring a **Social Media Manager** to own Beside’s organic presence across our brand channels and selected founder accounts.


You're a hands\-on, autonomous operator who knows what makes content work on social \- and turns raw material into a coherent, high\-quality presence.

* Own the social calendar, publishing, and day\-to\-day operation of our brand channels and selected founder accounts
* Decide what’s worth publishing, where it belongs, and when it should go live

* Find the strongest material across UGC, customer and team footage, product demos, and selected paid creative

* **Give every account a clear voice**

* Help selected founders turn their thinking and product moments into posts that feel like them
* Build recognizable formats that make our product, customers, and team worth following
* **Build a repeatable social engine**
* Build a reliable workflow from raw input to finished post so strong content gets published quickly and consistently
* Track performance and audience signals to understand what resonates

* You run your own YouTube channel and know what it takes to build content that lands

========================


At Beside, we don’t just build products \- we redefine how humans interact with each other. We believe in extreme ownership, radical transparency, where every team member is empowered to think, build, and lead. We operate with a written\-first, and public\-first culture, ensuring that decisions are made with clarity, speed, and impact.


This isn’t a rulebook \- it’s a manifesto for how we work, collaborate, and win. If you’re here, it means you’re ready to think like an owner, embrace ambiguity, and help shape the human\-machine interactions.

  

**Distributed ownership**
-------------------------


We don’t believe in hierarchy \- we believe in ownership. Strategic thinking, asking for help, and over\-communicating drive our collective success.

**Why we operate this way**


01 **Decisions.** People closest to the problem are the owners.


02 **Growth.** Big ownership fuels responsibility, engagement, and impact.


03 **Care.** Owners care. From midnight bug fixes to spotting flaws for launch.

**What this means day\-to\-day**


01 **Scope.** Everyone defines and evolves their mandate as the company grows.


02 **Coaching.** No managers or direct reports. Mentorship replaces hierarchy.


03 **Product.** Engineers own the full lifecycle: Scope Build Ship Measure.

  

**Public\-first culture**
-------------------------


Radical transparency isn’t optional \- it’s the operating system. When everything is accessible, we move faster, trust deeper, and execute harder.

**Why we operate this way**


01 **Context.** Shared data means sharper decisions, faster.


02 **Focus.** Transparency removes politics and second\-guessing.


03 **Fairness.** Everyone sees the same raises, reviews, and decisions.

**What this means day\-to\-day**


01 **Open.** No DMs; discussions and decisions happen in public channels.


02 **Visibility.** From co\-founders to newest hire: fundraising, board decks, metrics, compensation, reviews.


03 **Learning.** Documentation and open reflection turn mistakes into fuel.

  

**Written\-first philosophy**
-----------------------------


We default to writing, not meetings. In a global, remote team, writing keeps us aligned, accountable, and moving fast.

**Why we operate this way**


01 **Clarity.** Writing forces precision and strategic thinking.


02 **Scale.** Written decisions compound and serve everyone, present or not.

jobs.title: Manager, Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**


Crafty elevates workplace food and beverage programs with enhanced services managed in one innovative, centralized platform. Founded in 2015, our mission is to help companies craft better workplaces. From DraftKings to Robinhood to Zillow, we work with the world's biggest brands to foster a culture of employee connectivity and productivity. Headquartered in Chicago, with offices in New York and the Bay Area, Crafty manages food and beverage programs across 500\+ offices, serving more than 400,000 employees per month.


Our commitment to crafting better workplaces starts from within. We are a team of passionate, resourceful, and hard\-working trailblazers who love what we do. Our expertise spans technology, food and beverage operations, client success, fulfillment and more. At Crafty, our people are our greatest asset, because it's our people who foster a culture that makes our company a place worth being part of. *And of course, the snacks are the cherry on top!*

 **The Role**


The **Manager, Business Development** is responsible for the day\-to\-day management and coaching of Crafty's BDR team to drive national pipeline generation and contribute to new business revenue. This role owns frontline management of the BDR function — from assisting in recruiting and onboarding to training, coaching, and performance management — and partners closely with Sales, Marketing, and RevOps to optimize outbound strategies and team effectiveness.


Success in this role looks like:

* Consistent achievement of both pipeline generated and SQO targets
* A high\-performing, well\-developed BDR team (6\+ reps) with strong retention and clear career paths
* Proactive, data\-driven leadership visibility through structured reporting
* A BDR function that continuously evolves through process and coaching improvements

**Required Attributes**

* **Team leadership and development:** Leads and coaches a team of BDRs to achieve and exceed cold outreach targets and performance metrics. Develops personalized coaching plans based on call and email data, and proactively addresses performance gaps with clear expectations, support, and accountability.
* **Training strategy and curriculum:** Continuously improves a comprehensive training program covering cold emailing, cold calling, and social prospecting. Regularly updates materials to reflect industry trends and best practices, and delivers engaging onboarding and refresh sessions.
* **Performance analysis and coaching:** Uses data analytics to monitor individual and team performance, identify improvement opportunities, and provide structured feedback. Implements performance improvement plans for underperforming team members.
* **Process enhancement:** Collaborates cross\-functionally with Marketing, Sales, and RevOps to align BDR efforts with company goals and continuously refines outbound prospecting processes based on team insights and results.
* **Reporting and communication:** Prepares regular performance reports and team updates for Revenue leadership. Communicates clearly and proactively, ensuring stakeholders are informed on pipeline health, team standouts, and risks.
* **Hiring and talent management:** Partners with Director of Sales and People Ops to help attract, recruit, and retain top BDR talent.
* **Adaptability and initiative:** Operates effectively in a fast\-paced, constantly changing environment. Adjusts strategies quickly in response to business changes and models resilience for the team.

**Ideal Experience**

* 4\+ years of experience in business development or sales, with 1\+ years in a team management, training, or coaching capacity
* 18–24\+ months as a top\-performing BDR/SDR (consistently top\-third of your team), ideally in a comparable B2B outbound motion.
* Experience creating or materially improving a core element of the outbound function, such as an outreach sequence, call framework, ramp program, or quality assurance and coaching cadence.
* A demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding team pipeline and meetings\-booked targets across multiple consecutive quarters.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and drive coaching decisions
* Experience working cross\-functionally with Marketing, Sales, and RevOps
* Proficiency with sales tech stack: HubSpot, Apollo, Fathom, Trellus, SalesNav, Clay, Notion, Microsoft PowerPoint/Google Slides

*Don't meet all of the qualifications? We want you to consider all of your skills and experiences \- both professional and personal \- that would make you successful in this role. Although some qualifications are essential, others can be attained with time. We believe diverse perspectives, upbringings, and knowledge contribute to our strong company culture and we encourage you to apply.*

**SMART Goals**

* **Revenue generation (Pipeline \+ SQO balance):** By 12/31/2027, achieve $Xm in pipeline generated — tracked monthly in HubSpot — by managing the BDR team against both metrics simultaneously through weekly activity reviews, monthly individual coaching adjustments, and quarterly target recalibrations. Milestone: both metrics at or above pace by end of Q2\.
* **Individual and team development:** By 12/31/2027, establish a baseline measurement for each BDR and for the team overall across core outbound competencies and performance indicators, then demonstrate measurable quarter\-over\-quarter improvement through structured coaching plans, peer learning, and recurring development check\-ins. Milestone: baseline measurements completed by end of Q1, individual and team development plans live by end of Q2, and progress reviewed quarterly thereafter.
* **Team retention and stability:** By 12/31/2027, maintain current BDR team size with **0 unplanned attrition**, by proactively identifying retention risks, running monthly individual development check\-ins, and replacing any departures within 4 weeks to minimize pipeline impact. Milestone: full team headcoun

jobs.title: Special Education Compliance Program Coordinator - Georgia Connections Academy
jobs.description:
**School Summary**

Georgia Connections Academy is a tuition\-free, full\-time virtual school for students in grades K\-12 throughout Georgia. The school is authorized by the Georgia Charter Schools Commission and governed by an independent Board of Directors, with a mission to maximize academic achievement for students who are seeking other academic options. The school is operated by Georgia Connections Academy, a nonprofit corporation, through a contract with Connections Academy of Georgia, LLC, to provide its educational program and other services. Connections Academy, a division of Connections Education, is accredited by AdvancED, and GACA is accredited by the Southern Association of Colleges \& Schools Council on Accreditation and School Improvement.


*Georgia Connections Academy strives to create an inclusive environment that welcomes and values the diversity of the people we serve. We foster fairness, equity, and inclusion to create a workplace environment where everyone is treated with respect and dignity.*

**Position Summary**

Working from the Duluth, Georgia, office and from your home office within Georgia, certified teachers at Georgia Connections Academy support and motivate students through high\-quality virtual instruction using the Pearson Online Classroom. Teachers deliver synchronous and asynchronous instruction, provide intervention and enrichment, engage families, and use data to drive student learning and growth.



All GACA teachers and staff must be able to regularly participate in required in\-person activities that may require overnight travel throughout the state of Georgia, including but not limited to:


* School and department meetings
* Student engagement events
* Professional development and required training
* State testing, Diagnostic testing, and all in\-person summative and formative assessments
* Graduation and other school\-level events


Staff may also be required to support virtual administration of assessments, as scheduled by the school.


**Position Overview:**

Working from the Duluth office, the Program Coordinator of Special Education Compliance will be key in organizing and managing new teacher orientation, overseeing mentoring programs, and providing ongoing support to educators throughout the year. Additionally, this position will assist the Director of Special Education with special education compliance, special education instruction, communications, and data management. The Program Coordinator will assist in the management of the Special Education Department and will be a point of contact for families of students with disabilities. The Program Coordinator of Special Education will be an expert in Federal and State Special Education regulations.



This is a 12\-month, full\-time position.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Oversee Special Education Compliance Data;
* Assist the Special Education Leadership Team with audit reviews;
* Support professional development activities for case managers, teachers and school staff members;
* Manage and supervise special education case managers;
* Understand the requirements for and assist the state testing team to facilitate the administration of all district testing;
* Assist Special Education Leadership Team with the enrollment process including requesting appropriate paperwork and assuring all documents needed are obtained;
* Assist teachers when students enroll mid\-semester, making sure that teachers and case managers receive guidance on special education supports and services;
* Assist with the hiring and onboarding process of special education teachers and case managers;
* Assist with GO IEP organization and management, including onboarding and exiting students from platform, assisting with resolving support tickets, running regular compliance reports with follow up actions
* Other duties as assigned.


**Assessment \& Accountability**


* Administer formative and summative assessments, including monthly progress monitoring, CFAs, EOGs and EOCs where applicable.
* Participate in all required Georgia state standardized assessments in\-person and virtual sessions, including Georgia Milestones, ACCESS, Georgia Alternative Assessment, etc., in addition to End\-of\-Pathway, benchmarks, CFAs, and diagnostic assessments.
* Maintain accurate records of attendance, communication logs, academic progress, and intervention documentation.


**Collaboration \& Professional Practice**


* Work collaboratively within the Professional Learning Community to monitor data, plan instruction, and ensure student success.
* Partner with Advisory Teachers, School Counselors, Special Education staff, and team members to meet student needs and ensure strong communication loops.
* Support social, engagement, and community\-building activities—both virtual and in\-person—to cultivate belonging for students and families.
* Attend required school and district professional development and pursue ongoing growth in instructional practice.


**Community Engagement \& School Support**


* Assist in the organization and facilitation of school\-wide events (graduation, field trips, engagement activities).
* Participate in student recruitment efforts, marketing events, and family orientations as needed.
* Support the creation of a positive, inclusive virtual school culture through consistent communication, engagement, and community\-building practices.
* Perform other duties as assigned to support school operations, strategic initiatives, and student success.


**Essential Skills \& Competencies**


* Strong commitment to equitable practice, high expectations, and individualized student support
* Ability to use data to inform instruction and intervention
* Excellent communication and relationship\-building skills
* Effective collaboration within virtual and in\-person teams
* Strong organizational skills and timely completion of all required documentation
* Comfort with technology\-based instruction and virtual learning tools

Our university's vibrant culture, career opportunities, rich benefits, and values of respect, integrity, collaboration, inclusivity, and accountability make us an employer of choice. ---------------

Previous experience in order fulfillment, e\-commerce, supply chain, materials management and/or purchasing

Knowledge with best practices for inventory management

Excellent interpersonal, initiative, teamwork, problem solving, independent judgment, organization, communication (verbal and written), time management, project management and presentation skills

jobs.description:
**About Alston Construction:** Alston Construction Company is a nationwide general contractor, with 20 offices coast to coast. For 40 years, we have been a true partner, an honest advisor, as well as a responsible contractor for our clients. We believe the success of any project depends upon a strong builder client relationship, and a commitment to establishing common goals and objectives from the project start. Alston Construction offers a diverse background of general contracting, construction management and design\-build experience of industrial, commercial, healthcare, education, retail and government projects.

  

We look for passionate construction professionals who share our core values: commitment, integrity, teamwork, and respect. As our CEO, Paul Little, says “In order to be successful at Alston Construction, you must enjoy seeing success in others.” If this sounds like you and what you’re looking for, we’d love to hear from you!

  

Our top tier benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, prescription safety glasses, short\-term disability, long\-term disability, life insurance/AD\&D, HSA, health FSA, dependent daycare FSA, EAP, 401(k), Roth 401(k), After\-Tax Roth In\-Plan Conversion; paid vacation and sick time, paid holidays, tuition reimbursement, Tickets at Work, paid Identity Theft Protection (family coverage) and more!

 **Job Title: Safety Administrative Coordinator**

 **Job Summary:** Responsible for providing administrative training, reporting, and operational support to the Corporate Safety Department. This position plays an important role in maintaining accurate safety and training records, coordinating safety\-related programs and activities, supporting reporting requirements, and promoting consistency across the department. The overall goal of the Safety Administrative Coordinator is to be highly organized, detail\-oriented, comfortable working with technology and data, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced construction environment. This position reports to the Corporate Safety Director and works closely with Safety team members, Human Resources, Operations, and employees throughout the organization.

 **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**



The Safety Administrative Coordinator will include the following:


* Maintain accurate employee safety training records, certifications, and related documentation.
* Enter, update, and audit training information within the Company's learning management and/or safety systems.
* Assist employees and managers with training access, completion, and technical issues.
* Coordinate and assist with scheduling safety training sessions, meetings, orientations, and other safety\-related programs.
* Track required training and certifications and identify upcoming expirations, incomplete training, or other compliance gaps.
* Prepare training rosters, materials, reports, and other documentation as needed.
* Assist with communicating training requirements, deadlines, and program updates to employees and managers.
* Other related duties

  


**Education, Experience, and Licensing/Certifications:**


* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor’s degree preferred.
* 2–4 years of administrative, coordinator, training, compliance, safety, construction, or related experience preferred.
* Construction industry or safety department experience is a plus but not required

  


**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Experience supporting a multi\-location organization is preferred.
* Construction industry or safety department experience preferred.
* Experience with safety training or learning management systems.
* Experience maintaining employee training or certification records.
* Experience preparing or auditing reports and operational data.
* Familiarity with MVR administration or fleet/driver compliance.
* Familiarity with asset tracking and distribution.
* Experience working within the construction industry or another safety\-sensitive environment.

  



**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required Include:**


* High level of maturity and judgment; ability to be discreet and maintain confidentiality of information.
* Excellent skills in organization, time management, planning, and prioritization.
* Strong analytical skills.
* Effective communication skills (written and verbal) and presentation skills.
* Professional demeanor and effective interpersonal skills; ability to provide a high level of customer service and successfully interface with and maintain good working relationships with employees at all levels of the organization as well as external parties; ability to foster collaborative relationships.
* Skilled at active listening techniques. Gathers appropriate information before taking action and encourages others to listen and check before acting. Communications are tactful, diplomatic, and influential.
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities, shifting deadlines, and evolving business needs in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong proficiency with computers and software, to include Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.
* Working knowledge of artificial intelligence (AI) tools and an ability to use AI appropriately to improve efficiency, reporting, document preparation, research, data organization, and other administrative processes.
* Ability to effectively handle stress and stressful situations.
* Resourceful, proactive, and able to identify opportunities to improve processes, consistency, and efficiency.

  



This position will report to our office in Atlanta, GA.

 *Alston Construction is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

**Blitz Broadband – Woodstock, GA**

Blitz Broadband is looking for an organized, dependable, and proactive **Construction Production Coordinator** to work full\-time in our Woodstock, Georgia office.

The primary responsibility of this position is managing and monitoring our construction production information through Monday.com.

Monday.com works much like Excel and is used by our field crews to track daily production, labor, materials, equipment, and other job information that ultimately supports our customer billing.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain individual Monday.com boards for different construction projects.
* Monitor daily production information entered by field crews.
* Make sure crews are entering complete and accurate labor, material, equipment, and production information.
* Communicate with foremen, supervisors, subcontractors, and field crews by phone every day to correct missing or inaccurate information.
* Stay on top of crews and subcontractors when information has not been entered properly or on time.
* Review production information for accuracy before it moves into billing.
* Prepare weekly production documentation and information used to generate customer invoices.
* Help make sure completed work is captured, documented, and billed correctly.
* Assist with **subcontractor management**, including tracking production, paperwork, job status, required documentation, and follow\-up.
