* Track equipment assignments, locations, usage, service needs, maintenance records, and other fleet information.
* Help ensure company trucks, trailers, machinery, and equipment records remain current and organized.
* Maintain organized project records and tracking information.
* Assist the Office Manager with additional administrative and general office duties once primary responsibilities are complete.

**What We’re Looking For**

We need someone who is:

* Very organized and detail\-oriented.
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets, Excel\-type programs, and computer\-based tracking systems.
* Able to learn Monday.com quickly; previous Monday.com experience is a plus.
* Confident and professional on the phone.
* Comfortable calling field employees and subcontractors and holding them accountable for missing information.
* Good at following up and staying on top of multiple projects at the same time.
* Capable of managing fleet, equipment, and asset records accurately.
* Dependable and able to work independently.
* Construction, utility, telecom, fleet management, subcontractor management, job\-costing, production tracking, or invoicing experience is a plus.

This is an **in\-office position in Woodstock, Georgia**. It is not a remote position.

We are looking for someone who will take ownership of this role, communicate well with our field teams and subcontractors, and help keep our production, billing, fleet, equipment, and office operations organized and accurate.

* Experience with core cloud computing concepts and enterprise architecture principles, (e.g., networking, compute, storage, IT security, database systems, application development, operational frameworks).
* Experience presenting to technical and executive stakeholders (e.g., explaining technical concepts to non\-technical audiences).
* Experience supporting customers in cloud operations domains (e.g., launch/capacity planning, product release management, technical support, escalation management procedures).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* MBA or Master's degree in a Management, Technical, or Engineering field.
* Relevant technical professional certifications.
* Experience leading technical governance activities, such as establishing or actively participating in Architecture Review Boards (ARBs), or developing reference architectures and reusable patterns for an enterprise organization.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a Technical Success Account Manager (TSAM), you will serve as a strategic technical leader aligned with Google Cloud’s most critical customers. You will be responsible for driving sustained platform health, achieving technical excellence, and ensuring stability for key business critical workloads running on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will serve as the customer’s trusted technical advisor, translating complex business objectives into technical governance and modern, resilient cloud architectural strategies. You will advocate adoption of industry best practices and act as the primary point of accountability for resolving platform challenges and proactive risk mitigation, to the satisfaction of executive stakeholders.


This role requires independently forging strong executive relationships, advocating the implementation of Google Cloud architecture standards, elevating platform stability, and establishing technical accuracy across the customer’s GCP footprint, through a programmatic approach. Additionally, you will serve as the internal customer advocate, translating their strategic needs into actionable feedback for Google Cloud’s Product and Engineering teams, ensuring continuous service improvement and feature development.


Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $174000 \- $252000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Establish and lead technical governance, focusing on platform health metrics and enterprise readiness planning.
* Provide technical guidance and advocate the adoption of Google Cloud architecture and best practices via deep dives and workshops.
* Drive platform stability and excellence through deep architectural health assessments.
* Serve as the strategic technical advisor to address and resolve critical reliability concerns, advising on and guiding the architecture of highly robust, scalable, and resilient workloads.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**


Thrive delivers upon the promise of technology by enabling our clients’ digital transformation journeys with best practices on an AI, cybersecurity and cloud focused NextGen managed services platform.


Thrive’s culture is powered by diverse talent, big ideas, and a customer\-first mindset—and it’s what truly sets us apart. Thrive is built for people who want more than a weekday routine. If you’re hungry to grow, eager to tackle new challenges and ready to drive real impact in a rapidly expanding environment, then welcome to THRIVE!

**Position Overview**

As an Account Executive on Thrive’s Velocity team, you will drive revenue growth across a high\-volume portfolio of emerging and lower\-complexity accounts through proactive outbound outreach, upsell and cross\-sell selling, and disciplined pipeline management. This role is ideal for a motivated, early\-career sales professional who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, enjoys high activity, and is energized by building relationships, uncovering client needs, and closing transactional opportunities. You will partner closely with internal teams to deliver a strong customer experience while helping clients access the right Thrive solutions to support their business goals.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Manage and grow a designated portfolio of Velocity accounts through proactive outreach, relationship development, and opportunity identification
* Generate revenue by driving upsell, cross\-sell, and expansion opportunities across Thrive’s solutions and services
* Conduct a high volume of outbound calls, emails, and follow\-up activities to create pipeline and move opportunities forward
* Qualify client needs, identify buying signals, and align Thrive solutions to customer priorities using a consultative sales approach
* Own the sales process for transactional opportunities from initial outreach through quote, proposal, and close
* Maintain accurate account details, activity tracking, pipeline updates, and forecasting within Salesforce and related sales tools
* Partner effectively with internal stakeholders including service delivery, client success, solutions, and operations to support client needs and close business
* Monitor account activity, service trends, and customer feedback to identify retention risks and growth opportunities
* Meet or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets tied to bookings, activity, and account growth
* Build knowledge of Thrive’s services, value proposition, and key market trends to communicate confidently with clients
* Participate in sales training, coaching, role\-play, and enablement activities to strengthen selling capability and accelerate performance
* Complete required reporting, documentation, and administrative responsibilities with accuracy, timeliness, and professionalism

  

**Requirements** **Qualifications \& Experience:**

* 2\+ years of sales, inside sales, business development, account management, or customer\-facing revenue experience, preferably in technology, managed services, SaaS, or a related industry
* Demonstrated ability to manage a high volume of outreach and sales activity while maintaining strong follow\-up and organization
* Experience generating revenue through upsell, cross\-sell, renewals support, or transactional selling preferred
* Strong communication skills with the ability to build rapport, ask thoughtful questions, and clearly articulate value to clients
* Ability to identify opportunities, qualify needs, and advance deals in a fast\-paced, metrics\-driven sales environment
* Comfort using CRM tools such as Salesforce to manage pipeline, activity, and account information with discipline and accuracy
* Strong time management and organizational skills with the ability to prioritize across multiple accounts and opportunities
* Collaborative approach with the ability to work cross\-functionally and contribute to a strong team environment
* Curiosity, coachability, and willingness to learn Thrive’s solutions, sales process, and client needs quickly
* Bachelor’s degree preferred, but not required for candidates with relevant sales experience and a strong track record of performance

**Competencies to be Successful in the Role**

* Drive and Energy: Brings a high level of activity, urgency, and enthusiasm to managing accounts and creating opportunities
* Customer Focus: Builds strong relationships and looks for ways to help clients solve problems and gain value from Thrive’s solutions
* Sales Curiosity: Asks thoughtful questions, listens well, and uncovers underlying client needs and growth opportunities
* Communication: Communicates clearly, professionally, and confidently across phone, email, and virtual interactions
* Resilience: Stays motivated through rejection, setbacks, and changing priorities in a fast\-paced sales environment
* Organization and Discipline: Maintains strong follow\-up, pipeline hygiene, and attention to detail across a high volume of activity
* Coachability: Responds well to feedback, applies learning quickly, and shows a desire to continuously improve
* Collaboration: Works effectively with internal teams to support clients, solve problems, and move opportunities forward
* Adaptability: Adjusts quickly to new priorities, tools, messaging, and business needs in a growing organization
* Ownership: Takes accountability for results, follows through on commitments, and demonstrates pride in doing the job well

jobs.title: Associate National Account Manager
jobs.description:
**SUMMARY:**

FNA Group is a world class and leading manufacturer of consumer and industrial pressure washers and other outdoor power equipment. FNA's highly acclaimed brands include Simpson, Delco and CRX. Exclusive licenses with recognizable brands such as DeWalt, Stanley Black \& Decker and Craftsman further strengthens FNA's market presence and awareness. FNA is a dynamic organization with unprecedented growth due largely to its ability to attract and retain highly talented associates.


We have an excellent opportunity for a results\-oriented Associate National Account Manager who can work remotely from a home office in the southeastern United States.

 **Job Description:**


As an Associate National Account Manager for FNA Group, you will be responsible for developing and growing key retail partnerships within the company's consumers portfolio. You will support our sales initiatives with our customers in efforts of growing our business. Additionally, you will interface with FNA Group Demand Planning, Marketing, and Product teams in developing selling strategies, launching new products and aligning our forecast in efforts of delivering incremental business for your customers while maintaining targeted volume and profitability levels. The Associate National Account Manager can work remotely from a home office in the southeastern United States.

 **Duties / Responsibilities:**

* Support the National Account Team in developing and executing the annual account strategy and targets.
* Develop relationships with key customer partners across merchant, inventory, and online teams.
* Work cross\-functionally with internal teams to execute new product launches, maintain current listings, and identify opportunities with assortment.
* Master product knowledge for assigned customer.
* Ability to present in front of internal and external key decision makers.
* Assist in building customer presentations for product line reviews, business reviews, product launches, promotional planning, and assortment recommendations.
* Analyze POS, inventory, market\-share, promotional, and competitive data to identify risks and growth opportunities.
* Partner with demand planning and supply chain teams to ensure inventory aligns with retailer forecasts, promotions, resets, and product transitions.
* Coordinate new\-item setup, SKU maintenance, content readiness, pricing, packaging, samples, and retailer\-system requirements.
* Support assortment planning and recommendations across in\-store and online channels, including online exclusives, bundles, and promotional offers.
* Maintain competitive intelligence on products, pricing, features, promotions, customer reviews, and assortment changes.

* Experience in supporting Lowe's, The Home Depot, or another major national retailer is strongly preferred.

jobs.title: Customer Success Representative
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

Rhino Recon is looking for a proactive, results\-driven **Customer Success Specialist** to help our customers get consistent value from our platform while improving retention and reducing preventable churn.

This is not a traditional customer service position. You'll actively monitor customer engagement, identify at\-risk accounts, provide training, solve implementation challenges, and intervene before customers disengage or cancel.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage ongoing customer relationships after initial onboarding and the 14\-day Sales check\-in.
* Monitor customer usage and maintain Healthy, At Risk, and Critical account statuses.
* Proactively contact customers showing declining or limited engagement.
* Help customers build effective prospecting workflows using Rhino Recon.
* Conduct customer training and recurring webinars.
* Handle cancellation conversations and execute approved retention strategies.
* Follow up with saved customers to ensure they remain active and engaged.
* Assist with failed\-payment recovery and account retention.
* Maintain accurate CRM notes, follow\-ups, customer health statuses, and cancellation reasons.
* Communicate recurring customer feedback, product issues, and improvement opportunities to leadership.

**What We're Looking For**

We're looking for someone who is organized, persistent, personable, and comfortable taking initiative. You should be confident speaking with customers by phone and video, learning software, solving problems, and having difficult conversations when necessary.

Experience in Customer Success, SaaS, Account Management, Retention, Sales, or the contractor/home\-services industry is a plus.

**Why Join Rhino Recon?**

This is an opportunity to take meaningful ownership over an important function within a growing SaaS company. You'll work directly with customers, leadership, Sales, Marketing, and Development and have the ability to influence how Rhino Recon approaches customer retention, training, onboarding, and product improvement.

We're looking for someone who doesn't wait for a customer to say, "I want to cancel."

We're looking for someone who notices the customer stopped using the platform weeks earlier and does something about it.

Pay: $45,000\.00 \- $55,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Job Title: Operations Specialist  

Location: Marietta, GA  

Employee Type: Full Time  

Pay Rate: $22\.50 \+ Full Benefit Package (day one)


We want you to be a part of our team — not just for a job, but for a long\-term career. We're committed to investing in your growth, helping you build your skills, and supporting your professional development every step of the way. As a key player in our success, you’ll work with some of the largest fleet companies in America and gain hands\-on experience with our 209 unique vehicle models. Join us and grow your future with a company that believes in your potential.  

  

Flexcar is completely reimagining car ownership. We offer the world’s first month\-to\-month car lease, with insurance and maintenance included. Members can swap cars anytime as their needs change, without the commitment or hassle of traditional car ownership. By combining operational expertise with technology, data, and AI, we’re transforming every aspect of the customer journey and delivering a more affordable, flexible, and hassle\-free alternative to buying or leasing.


The Operations Specialist is a key employee at Flexcar that will work closely with teams from each frontline department to ensure the best products and experiences for our customers. As an Operations Specialist, you will be responsible for cleaning cars to meet Flexcar standards, ensuring all quality checks are being done through various apps and checklists, taking quality photos of vehicles for display on our website, and inventory scanning. You will primarily be stationed outdoors in one of our market locations while you perform your daily tasks.

  

What You’ll Do:

* Clean and detail a high volume of cars inside and out to meet Flexcar standards
* Assess vehicle quality and damage by using our technology
* Communicate with other Flexcar team members using a smart device
* Complete readiness and return checklists accurately and quickly
* Complete infleet inspections and the vehicle optioning process
* Use our technology to take consistent high\-quality images for our website
* Conduct accurate, daily complete inventory scans, and assist with reconciliation process
* Work on various special projects \- managing their moving parts, timelines, and stakeholders \- as dictated by unique business needs in an emerging market.
* Properly manage vehicle inventory, including organizing a parking lot and correctly labeling cars
* Address issues with vehicles to return them to customers as quickly as possible.
* Maintain all Flexcar facilities and property to company standards
* Assist the order delivery team to deliver customer cars for orders, as needed
* Complete other assigned tasks from team leads and managers as directed


What You’ll Love About this Role:

* Being a core member of the Operations Team – our customer safety depends on you!
* Being part of an automotive company that recognizes talent – where you can make a difference.
* We are growing quickly – which means your career can grow quickly with us too!


What Drives Success for this Role:

* Being an effective multitasker with strong time management skills
* Tech savviness – you'll be using a company provided smartphone throughout your day to manage tasks
* Ability to work in a customer\-centric environment
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Operating as a team player in a fast\-paced environment
* Flexibility to workdays, evenings, weekends and/or holidays
* Willingness to work outdoors (weather and other conditions vary)
* Ability to carry tools and marketing materials (up to 50 lbs.)
* Valid driver’s license and an acceptable driving record (per company standards)
* At least 18 years old


What tops the tank:

* Rest \& Relax! Potential to accrue 80 hours of PTO your first year, and up to 120 hours in later years plus multiple company paid holidays and 60 hours of Sick time.
* Save for Your Future! 401(k) with company match from day one of hire
* Benefits: Excellent, low\-cost healthcare coverage including: medical, dental, vision, eligibility day one. Wellness Programs, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Account, Life and Disability Insurance
* Drive a Flexcar! Discounted employee rate on Flexcar products and no annual membership fee
* Weekly Pay and Employee Referral Bonus
* Uniforms
* and other amazing perks!

This role is designed for individuals who are eager to learn, grow, and develop their enterprise sales skills in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment. You’ll gain exposure to the full sales cycle — from lead qualification to pipeline support — while collaborating closely with experienced sales professionals and cross\-functional teams.


Core Responsibilities

* Engage inbound and outbound enterprise leads to assess interest, fit, and readiness for the client’s products and solutions.

jobs.description:
Simpson Strong\-Tie is a leader in engineered structural connectors, software, and solutions for the building industry. We maintain a reputation as a trusted manufacturer, partner, and corporate citizen committed to our customers and employees.


Our founder, Barc Simpson established 9 Principles of Business we live out as company values and have made Simpson Strong\-Tie an inspiring place to work since 1956\. Our team of talented people are dedicated to our shared mission: to provide solutions that help people design and build safer, stronger structures.


Learn about our company culture directly from our team.

**YOU**


As the Territory Sales Representative (TSR) \- Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM), you will be responsible for growing OEM sales in the North Carolina and South Carolina territory. You will coordinate with and contribute to the overall branch and company efforts to profitably grow our business. The OEM market segment encompasses sales to any company that may use Simpson products in the manufacturing/assembly of another product for sale. As the Territory Sales Representative \- OEM you are responsible for sales of all Simpson product lines based on customer needs, competition, and market potential and will help to formulate and execute the business strategy in your territory. You will also lead and participate in training sessions/workshops in and out of the territory. These workshops require scheduling, promotion, set\-up, presentation, and take\-down, as well as providing observation and suggestions for improvement. You will work with Regional Sales Managers, Product Management, Marketing, and other TSRs to develop/coordinate sales strategies and programs; and communicate appropriate market trends and field intelligence to provide to Management and Operations to ensure customer satisfaction.

**WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING** (% of Time)


Drive demand and grow sales of all Simpson product lines in the defined marketplace. This includes prospecting, conducting sales calls, identifying opportunities, giving presentations including hands on demonstrations, training, repairing tools, Analyze industry and market needs and develop the appropriate strategies, forecast territory demand, and provide support as needed by the customer and/or company. Assist in securing and maintaining product specifications from structural engineers and other specifiers. (65%)


Develop and maintain key relationships with customers, as well as managing supply chain relationships with channel partners. Provide ongoing training sessions, product demos and technical support and be a problem solver for customers. Understand customers’ pricing structure. (15%)


Promote Simpson Strong\-Tie as an industry partner and potential employer; participate in tradeshows, association meetings and various committees and/or causes; provide educational opportunities in classroom settings throughout your territory including but not limited to suppliers, specifiers, building officials, contractors, and homeowners. (10%)


Other duties and responsibilities, including but not limited to, consistent CRM management and usage, scheduling, business planning, submitting expense reports in a timely manner, regular maintenance of company\-owned vehicles, and other duties as assigned. (10%)

**DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**


If you can do everything listed above, you’ve got what it takes. Perhaps some of the following would be helpful too:

* Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* 3\-5 years of industry experience and/or training. Fluent in OEM construction practices and distribution channels. Must have a strong working knowledge of project workflow from architect/engineer to the contractor. Sales and account management experience with a proven track record of sales/profit growth preferred.
* Technical: Have the ability to gain product knowledge in order to become a trusted resource for Simpson Products and solutions as well as working with Specialists to provide support as needed.
* Presentation Skills: Ability to develop and present captivating presentations and incorporate sales skills to step a prospect through a story.
* Creative \& Innovative Thinking: Ability to exhibit creativity and innovation when contributing to organizational and individual objectives.
* Decision Making \& Judgement: Ability to balance analysis, wisdom, experience, and perspective when making decisions.
* Accountability \& Dependability: Ability to fulfill all commitments made to peers, co\-workers, and supervisor.
* Adaptability \& Flexibility: Ability to respond positively to change, embracing and using new practices or values to accomplish goals and solve problems.
* Customer Focus: Ability to build and sustain productive customer relationships.
* Self\-Awareness: Ability to find and maximize opportunities for growth and development.
* Proactivity: Ability to identify what needs to be done and take action, when situation requires it.
* Influence: Ability to address issues in an open, constructive, professional manner.
* Organization \& Prioritization: Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously as well as quickly reallocate resources in order to respond to changing customer and team member needs.
* Computer/Software/Technology: Proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office (including Outlook, Excel, Word and Power Point), Salesforce CRM, SAP ERP, and other industry standard software packages. Ability to learn new systems in a timely manner.

**TRAVEL REQUIRED**


This job requires 50% domestic travel.

This full\-time, exempt position may be based in either North Carolina or South Carolina to support coverage of the assigned NC/SC territory.

jobs.description:
**TITLE: Inside Sales Representative**
**LOCATION: Atlanta, GA**
**POSITION SUMMARY****:** The Inside Sales Representative plays a pivotal role in driving revenue growth by identifying, qualifying, and closing new business opportunities in designated expansion markets. Operating as a strategic revenue generator, this role focuses on selling custom data center maintenance/servicing, engineering, and construction solutions to enterprise clients, cloud providers, and hyperscalers.
The ideal candidate combines strong outbound business development skills with technical aptitude, managing the end\-to\-end sales pipeline while building key vendor relationships to maximize deal velocity and solution delivery. This position is responsible for managing the long tail of customers and driving incremental growth from them by positioning the full portfolio of services offered by CPG.
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**: *To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform the following satisfactorily; other duties may be assigned. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*
* Conduct outbound business development, prospecting, and lead follow up on target accounts within expansion territory.
* Manage the full inside sales cycle from initial contact to deal closure, ensuring high conversion rates through proactive lead management.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with customers to ensure CPG is well positioned for additional business and growth within the accounts.
* Maintain complete and accurate account, opportunity, and activity records in NetSuite CRM.
* Build and manage an up\-to\-date sales pipeline, delivering accurate monthly and quarterly revenue forecasts to leadership.
* Meet with existing or potential clients and attend site visits as required.
* Coordinate with solutions engineers and estimating teams to prepare quotes, technical proposals, and service contracts.
* Build and nurture strong relationships with key vendors, distribution partners, and equipment suppliers.
* Act as the primary liaison between CPG sales operations, external vendor reps, and the client throughout the sales and occasionally execution phases.
* Coordinate between numerous internal Line of Business managers and external vendor partners to communicate CPG’s full capabilities out to potential and existing customers.

**Who We Are**  

Neighborly Software was built to help communities make a difference in the lives of low\-income families and vulnerable populations. Our mission is simple, “Helping Communities, Help People.”

**People Operations Coordinator**


We're looking for a motivated People Operations Coordinator to join our growing People team. We're in high\-growth mode, so this role will initially focus on **recruiting** — supporting the full recruitment lifecycle from sourcing and screening candidates to coordinating interviews and delivering a great candidate experience.


As we scale, you will serve as a backup to our People Ops team on general support, including onboarding, employee records, and other People team initiatives. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who wants to build deep recruiting expertise while developing into a well\-rounded People Operations professional.

**What You'll Do**

*Recruiting (primary focus)*

* Source candidates through job boards, Juicebox, LinkedIn, employee referrals, and other channels

* Support employer branding efforts (career page content, social media, etc.)
* Assist with offer letter preparation and pre\-employment processes (background checks, assessments)
* Continuously look for ways to improve recruiting processes and candidate experience

*General HR Support (as we scale)*

* Support new hire onboarding, including paperwork, systems setup, and first\-week logistics

* Assist with day\-to\-day employee questions on policies, benefits, and general HR processes
* Help coordinate logistics for training, company events, and other People team programs

* 1–3\+ years of experience in a staffing agency, corporate talent acquisition, or a broader HR/People Operations role

* Familiarity with ATS platforms (e.g., Ashby, Greenhouse, etc.) is a plus

* Exposure to HRIS platforms (e.g., Rippling, BambooHR, Workday) or general HR administration
* Basic knowledge of employment law and compliance requirements

* **401K Contributions** – Generous employer match with immediate vesting
* **Generous Time Off** – 5 weeks of PTO, 9 paid holidays, and 3 days of volunteer time off each year

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.*

**Title:** OEM Account \& Program Coordinator

**Location:** Elk Grove, IL

**Reports to:** OEM Sales Director

**About Rensa**


Rensa Filtration is a family of companies dedicated to air filtration. By investing in innovation and the people who drive it, we manufacture, market, and distribute best\-in\-class solutions throughout the United States, Canada, and Europe that keep environments safe and industries thriving.

**What We Do**

* We improve the environment by making indoor and outdoor spaces cleaner and eliminating process contaminants through superior products and filtration media.
* We drive innovation in air filtration by investing in the people and companies that develop the solutions today’s world demands. We bring these innovative products to market so our customers can provide maximum value and safety to the facilities and businesses they serve.

***OEM Account \& Program Coordinator***


The OEM Account \& Program Coordinator will provide direct support to the OEM Sales Director and help manage the day\-to\-day needs of our growing OEM customer base.


This position will play an important role in keeping customer projects, quotations, purchase orders, samples, forecasts, and internal follow\-up activities moving forward. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, detail\-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities. This individual must communicate effectively with customers and collaborate with internal Sales, Engineering, Quality, Customer Service, Production, and Supply Chain teams.


This role is designed to allow the OEM Sales Director to remain focused on strategic customer relationships, new business development, and revenue growth while ensuring existing opportunities and customer commitments receive consistent follow\-through.

***ESSENTIAL POSITION DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES***

* Provide day\-to\-day administrative, account, and sales support to the OEM Sales Director.
* Assist with preparing, submitting, and tracking customer quotations and requests for quotations.
* Maintain quote logs and use the CRM system to document and follow up on outstanding quotations, samples, opportunities, and customer requests.
* Assist with processing customer purchase orders and verifying pricing, minimum order quantities, lead times, product information, and order status.
* Track open purchase orders and coordinate with internal teams to obtain updated production and shipping dates.
* Identify potential delays and communicate with the appropriate internal teams to ensure customer commitments are addressed proactively.
* Coordinate customer sample requests and prototype orders.
* Own and maintain customer forecasts and communicate anticipated demand to Operations and Supply Chain.
* Support new product and OEM project coordination from the initial request for quotation through production.
* Coordinate with Engineering and Quality regarding drawings, specifications, testing requirements, approvals, and customer documentation.
* Maintain accurate customer pricing, product information, specifications, account records, and correspondence.
* Prepare sales reports, opportunity updates, customer summaries, and other information required by the OEM Sales Director.
* Assist with customer presentations, meetings, and follow\-up action items.
* Communicate directly with customers, when appropriate, regarding routine order, quotation, sample, and project updates.
* Work closely with Customer Service, Production, Engineering, Quality, and Supply Chain to ensure customer requirements are clearly communicated and addressed.
* Maintain organized documentation and correspondence for key OEM accounts.
* Follow up consistently on internal and customer action items to ensure projects continue moving forward.
* Support additional OEM sales initiatives and projects as assigned.
* Clearly communicate open issues and escalate concerns when additional support or management involvement is required.

***REQUIRED SKILLS \& ABILITIES***

* Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with pricing, dimensions, part numbers, purchase orders, forecasts, and customer specifications.
* Ability to communicate professionally and effectively with customers.
* Ability to collaborate across Sales, Customer Service, Production, Engineering, Quality, and Supply Chain.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of follow\-up items, and recognize when an issue requires escalation.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Word, and other standard business applications.
* Experience working with ERP and CRM systems is preferred.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced OEM sales and manufacturing environment.

***KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS KPIs AND DEFINITION OF SUCCESS***

* Customer requests, quotations, samples, and project updates are completed accurately and on time.
* Outstanding quotations and opportunities receive consistent follow\-up.
* Open purchase orders are proactively monitored, and potential delays are escalated promptly.
* Customer forecasts, pricing, product information, and account records remain accurate and current.
* Internal and customer action items are documented, assigned, and completed within the expected timeframe.
* Customer requirements and commitments are clearly communicated to the appropriate internal departments.
* OEM projects continue progressing from the initial request for quotation through production without preventable delays.
* The OEM Sales Director receives reliable administrative and program support that allows greater focus on strategic customer relationships, new business development, and revenue growth.

* Four or more years of experience in sales support, customer service, account coordination, project coordinat

Participates in outbreak and control activities. Provides training and establishes strategic priorities in the areas of syndromic, wastewater, and seasonal surveillance, as well as other non\-traditional surveillance data sources.

* Assists with immunization data analysis and reporting, particularly for respiratory immunizations.
* Keeps the Director fully informed of pertinent information and follows through on assignments.
* Explores and develops methods for communicable disease forecasting and modeling.
* Analyzes and interprets data to identify epidemic trends and makes recommendations for strategies related to policy development, prevention, and program planning.
* Supports informatics and data modernization initiatives, such as electronic case reporting.
* Identifies new data sources for enhanced surveillance.
* Maintains an enhanced surveillance procedure manual.
* Collaborates with local, state, and federal partners in enhanced surveillance initiatives, including participation in relevant communities of practice.
* Supports quality improvement projects.
* Participates and represents the agency at specified meetings and responds to inquiries from the public, media and health care professionals.
* Available for on\-call duties.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

* Five (5\) years of experience in disease surveillance and control or epidemiologic data analysis.
* Two (2\) years of supervisory and/or managerial experience in relevant public health programs
* Proficient in R, SAS, or Python
* Proficient using Microsoft Office

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in communicable disease investigation.
* Advanced knowledge of statistical methods

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities and Other Characteristics**

* Working knowledge of communicable disease regulations
* Comprehensive knowledge of theories, principles and practice of epidemiology and biostatistics in the field of public health
* Proficiency in the use of electronic databases and statistical software programs used for epidemiological analysis
* Proficiency in the use of computer software used for mapping
* Excellent verbal, written communication, and interpersonal skills necessary to communicate with all levels of staff and a patient population composed of diverse cultures and age groups
* Skill in planning, developing and completing complex assignments with minimal direction.
* Accurate judgment in making decisions and in meeting new problems
* Ability to work independently Ability to accurately and effectively respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers, regulatory agencies, or members of the public health community
* Ability to effectively present information to top management, public groups, and/or boards of directors
* Ability to make sound discretionary decisions
* Ability to work well under pressure
* Ability to represent CCDPH with tact and diplomacy
* Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team

At Avnet, relationships matter. We are a global, FORTUNE ® 500 technology distributor and solutions company that delivers design, supply chain and logistics expertise to customers at every stage of a product’s lifecycle. We’re driven to help our customers around the world succeed and we do so by earning the trust of some of the biggest names in technology.


Working at Avnet means being a part of a global team. We work collaboratively and with integrity, doing business the right way. jobs.description:
### **WE ARE STARFACE**



Since launching in 2019, Starface has turned the historically negative experience of having acne into a more joyful, relatable one with a category of its own: expressive and effective products that make people feel good. With a full suite of hydrocolloid pimple patches in bright colors and a roster of limited\-edition collaborations— from fan\-favorite characters like Hello Kitty and Snoopy to fashion brands like Marc Jacob’s Heaven—it’s easy to see why Starface users say they look forward to getting breakouts. Featuring award\-winning formulas and ultra\-cute packaging, Starface products are designed to make you smile every time you use them.

### **your impact @ starface**



Starface is seeking an **Account Manager** to help bring day\-to\-day account management in\-house across our Drug, Specialty, and Beauty channels, building stronger direct retailer relationships and creating greater ownership, consistency, and accountability across the business. In this role, you’ll report directly to our Account Director. You’ll own the day\-to\-day management of some key retail accounts (e.g. Walgreens, CVS) and collaborate with the Account Director in supporting others (e.g. Ulta). both owning and supporting (but not limited to) retailer communication, sales reporting and forecasting, promotional and launch execution, and cross\-functional follow\-up



The right person for this role is organized, proactive, detail\-oriented, and comfortable independently owning their business while collaborating closely across teams. You have experience supporting or managing retail accounts within beauty, CPG, wellness, or another fast\-paced consumer products environment and understand the details that go into successfully managing retail partnerships.



At Starface, we find fun, lead with care, aim high, stay curious, and move forward. We love people who defy convention and welcome an attitude of exploration into the bold and creative in all that we do. * Maintain a strong understanding of retailer\-specific processes, tools, promotional calendars, assortment, and upcoming launches
* While this is a remote position, you will be expected to attend in\-person meetings in the local Chicago, IL area \+ travel 10\-20% for company and team\-specific off\-sites and events.

### **this role is for you if**


* You have experience supporting or managing retail accounts within beauty, CPG, wellness, or another fast\-paced consumer products environment
* You have direct experience working directly with CVS and/or Walgreens without a broker; experience with Ulta and/or specialty retailers is a plus
* You understand core retail account management fundamentals, including POS, forecasting, promotional planning, assortment, new item launches, resets, inventory, and retailer tools or portals
* You’re highly organized and detail\-oriented, with an understanding that accuracy matters when working across POs, forecasting, sales reporting, and retailer commitments
* You’re proactive and comfortable independently managing day\-to\-day responsibilities, identifying issues before they escalate, and following through on commitments
* You’re comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly and approach challenges with a solutions\-oriented mindset
* You’re curious about the “why” behind the business and use data and context to understand what is driving performance, where risks exist, and where opportunities may be
* You’re a collaborative partner who communicates clearly, works effectively across teams and levels, and is willing to jump in where needed
* You’re comfortable speaking up, asking thoughtful questions, and bringing a fresh perspective while remaining open to different ideas and ways of working
* You are located in the Chicago, IL area.

### **salary \& benefits**

	+ Flexible Fridays, and Summer Fridays
	+ Fully remote work environment
	+ ...and much, much more!

You will shape how mid\-market CPG and Ecommerce clients leverage Meta's advertising platform to reach consumers, drive conversions, and scale their businesses.  

  

  

### **Sales Manager, Mid\-Market Account Management Responsibilities:**

* Lead and develop a team of account managers responsible for growing a portfolio of mid\-market CPG and Ecommerce advertisers on Meta's advertising platform
* Define and execute a strategic vision for the mid\-market CPG and Ecommerce segment, identifying growth opportunities and setting team priorities aligned to revenue goals
* Coach account managers on consultative selling techniques, campaign optimization strategies, and stakeholder management across internal partners (cross\-functional teams, specialists, leadership) and external clients
* Partner with cross\-functional teams including marketing, product, measurement, and operations to deliver integrated solutions that address CPG and Ecommerce client needs
* Analyze team and portfolio performance data to identify trends, surface insights, and adjust go\-to\-market strategies for the CPG and Ecommerce vertical
* Represent the mid\-market CPG and Ecommerce segment in cross\-functional planning discussions, contributing to product feedback loops and vertical\-specific initiatives
* Develop and maintain relationships with key mid\-market clients and agency partners to support account growth and retention
* Drive operational excellence across the team by establishing scalable systems, repeatable frameworks, and structured processes for pipeline management, forecasting, and account planning
* Filter and prioritize organizational communications to maintain team focus, translating business changes into clear and actionable guidance
* Build and sustain team culture and cohesion across a distributed team, fostering connection through in\-person engagement and deliberate team\-building efforts
* Recruit, onboard, and retain account management talent, building a high\-performing team culture grounded in accountability and client impact

The company's Predictive Yes Platform helps businesses say yes to more \- more good customers, more revenue, and more growth \- without getting burned. jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
Runwise is looking for a Business Development Representative (BDR) to help our rapidly scaling and mission\-driven sales team form even deeper relationships with the biggest names in Real Estate.


**The Team**



Runwise (www.runwise.com) is a fast\-paced, customer\-focused climate\-tech startup that controls and runs the key energy systems (heating, water, etc…) in 8,000\+ buildings throughout the US. Runwise's unique hardware and software service significantly reduces energy usage, substantially lowering costs and carbon output. As of today, Runwise's technology takes the equivalent of 100,000 cars worth of carbon emissions off the road each year.


**The Role**



As a BDR at Runwise, you will own a list of one hundred and fifty of the biggest names in Real Estate. Roughly half of these accounts will be existing customers, while the other half have not yet worked with us. Paired with a Senior Account Executive (who is an expert in the industry) you will be charged with getting Runwise in front of key accounts for portfolio expansion conversations and net new growth opportunities. As the conversations progress, you will support in putting together sales pitches, proposals, and pricing to drive a substantial portion of the company's revenue. BDRs will need to learn industry dynamics, organization structures, and the motivations of each buyer persona. BDRs need to know how to prospect for the right contacts strategically, break into complex organizations, and dynamically tailor the offering to drive decisions.



The right candidate is someone who is goal\-oriented, thinks out of the box, has strong presentation skills, and is highly organized. The right candidate can think a few steps ahead and can connect dots between accounts, contacts, and locations to act relationally. The right candidate can switch between calls, strategy and administrative work in an efficient manner.


**Responsibilities**


* Identify key players, analyze business cases for Runwise, and formulate a pitch
* Leverage a variety of data tools to locate contact information for an account
* Utilize calls, emails, and other creative tactics to connect with accounts
* Partner with a Senior Account Executives to make sure their pipeline continues to grow and deals move swiftly down the funnel
* Generate professional presentations and error free proposals on quick deadlines
* Maintain clean systems and gain proficiency in CRM (Salesforce), automated email tools (Outreach), lead gen tools, city databases, and excel.

**Qualifications**



This position requires an ambitious self\-starter and someone that can effectively connect with Senior level decision makers. Relationship selling skills, with the ability to make a compelling business case, are essential.


* 3\-5 years as an SDR, Account Manager or Account Executive.
* Exceptional communication skills, both oral and written, coupled with excellent listening skills and a positive and energetic phone presence.
* High level of integrity and an energetic commitment to building a successful company.
* Ability to work independently as well as partner with a Senior Account Executive in a fast\-paced environment.
* Adept computer skills including proficiency with LinkedIn, Google Suite.
* Experience with CRM applications preferred.


On Target Earning: **$115,000**


**What you believe:**


* No job is too small.
* Sincerity builds trust.
* Setbacks fuel progress.
* Efficiency is vital.


**Benefits:**


* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* HSA \& FSA options
* Paid Parental Leave
* Access to Talkspace \& Health Advocate
* Flexible PTO
* Commuter Benefits
* 401K
* Company paid life insurance
* Voluntary supplemental life insurance
* Free in\-office lunch on Wednesdays
* Hybrid work environment
* Summer Fridays
* Monthly L\&D Series
* Employee Resource Groups (e.g. DEIB Committee, Run Club)


***This is an excellent opportunity to join a fast\-growing company, one of the true leaders within energy efficiency in the Chicago You will be surrounded by talented people, including working very closely with our co\-founder and sales leader. Your success will also make a tangible impact on reducing carbon emissions across the country, within the cities where we operate.***

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Business Development Representative (BDR)**
=============================================

**Location:** Chicago, IL  

**Schedule:** Hybrid (minimum 3 days per week in our Chicago office)

**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for a highly motivated Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our growing sales organization. This person will be on the front lines of our go\-to\-market motion, responsible for generating qualified opportunities for our sales team by engaging CFOs, GCs, Corporate Secretaries, Equity Administrators, and capital\-markets executives at some of the most innovative companies in the world.


You'll be responsible for creating qualified pipeline through thoughtful research, outreach, strong discovery, and clear communication. This is a Chicago\-based role, and candidates must be able to work in our Chicago office at least three days per week.

**Role Requirements**
---------------------

* Intrinsically motivated self\-starter, willing to do whatever it takes to be successful in growing Vinyl Equity
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; you ask precise questions and articulate complex ideas simply
* Ability to manage structured outbound outreach to senior executives (CFO, GC, Corporate Secretary, Equity Admin)
* Build and maintain a healthy top\-of\-funnel pipeline using targeted email, phone, LinkedIn, and industry research
* Comfort operating within a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment where processes evolve quickly
* Demonstrated discipline with CRM hygiene, follow\-up, and detailed documentation
* A growth mindset and willingness to iterate, learn, and improve daily
* Ability to collaborate closely with the sales team to support strategic deal cycles
* Represent Vinyl Equity with professionalism and industry fluency in every interaction
* Must be based in Chicago and able to be in\-office 3\+ days per week
* Bachelor's degree

**Nice to Haves**
-----------------

* Prior BDR or other customer\-facing experience
* Familiarity with HubSpot
* Experience selling into financial services, fintech, SaaS, or B2B enterprise accounts
* Exposure to equity management, corporate governance, or capital markets
* Experience at a high\-growth startup

**You could be a great fit if**
-------------------------------

* You communicate with clarity: succinct, direct, and confident with senior audiences
* You enjoy guiding prospects through the early stages of their buying process by identifying pain, impact, and urgency
* You are curious, intellectually engaged, and eager to become an expert in capital markets, equity operations, and compliance workflows
* You take pride in operational excellence, including precise CRM updates, tight follow\-ups, and well\-structured outreach sequences
* You're motivated by fast growth and excited by the pace, autonomy, and opportunity that comes with an early\-stage startup
* You bring persistence and grit, and you are energized by hitting ambitious pipeline goals
* You thrive in environments where creativity and problem\-solving are essential to success
* You're energized by the idea of helping introduce real innovation into an industry that has largely stood still for nearly three decades
* You're comfortable with (and thrive in) ambiguity. This role will be essential in defining how Vinyl goes to market, but will require agency to ensure that we take nothing for granted and leave no stones unturned. There is no concrete playbook for outbound sales in this industry. We're defining it.

**You may not be a great fit if**
---------------------------------

* You dislike prospecting. This role requires consistent outbound sourcing.
* You prefer to leave product knowledge to others. Our expectation is that our entire GTM team will develop deep product and market fluency.
* You resist structured documentation or CRM hygiene.
* You prefer slow\-changing environments or rigid process definitions.
* You are uncomfortable engaging senior executives early in the sales process.
* You prefer to fit into a structured commercial environment with predetermined outbound clarity.

**Our Philosophy**
------------------


A few principles that guide how we operate at Vinyl Equity:

* We value high\-agency ownership, first\-principled thinking, thoughtful communication, and a bias toward action
* We believe small, exceptionally talented teams outperform larger teams with average talent
* We aim to demonstrate both product and industry expertise in every interaction with prospects and customers
* Creativity, drive, innovation, and consistency win in otherwise stagnant industries
* Act with high integrity without compromise

**Compensation and Benefits (for U.S.\- based full\-time employees)**
---------------------------------------------------------------------

* Base: $50,000–$75,000
* OTE: $75,000–$95,000 (uncapped commission, paid quarterly)
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401k
* Flexible PTO
* Hybrid work schedule
* Equity\-based compensation

Supports the delivery of the division's virtual professional learning opportunities for the field by assisting facilitators, taking attendance, supporting participant communication, and closing rosters. **Provivi Overview:**



Provivi™ is a California\-based, globally operating AgTech company using pheromones to protect crops from major damaging insects. Our patented production method enables a step change in the cost of manufacturing pheromones, allowing us to pioneer the use of this proven tool in high\-acreage crops such as corn, rice and soy.

Because this is a working laboratory environment, the role requires comfort operating around laboratory supplies, chemicals, equipment, and established safety procedures. Scientific expertise is not required.

* Monitor facility and office supplies, maintain appropriate inventory levels, and reorder as needed.

Shipping, Receiving \& Inventory

* Partner with R\&D on facility needs while leaving scientific and technical decisions with appropriate R\&D team members.


Safety \& Compliance


* Conduct and document routine interior and exterior facility and laboratory safety inspections and escalate concerns promptly.

* Maintain facility safety documentation, including SDS records and applicable vendor and waste documentation. Following up with suppliers in the event an SDS is required on file.
* Coordinate periodic safety walkthroughs with R\&D and other appropriate stakeholders.

* Maintain facility records, schedules, and documentation while identifying practical ways to improve reliability, organization, and cost.

  


**Qualifications \& Skills Include:**


* Prior experience in facilities coordination, office/lab operations, workplace operations, or a similar hands\-on operational role.
* Strong organizational skills and comfort managing many small, recurring responsibilities without requiring significant oversight.
* Experience coordinating vendors, supplies, deliveries, shipping, or facility services.
* Ability to identify an issue, determine the appropriate next step, and follow it through to completion.

new_jobs.description:
**Role Purpose**


This role sits within the Edge Product area of Accenture Global IT, acting as the primary account management and product liaison between Dell and the wider Accenture organization. The role manages the day\-to\-day Dell relationship, represents Accenture's interests in product and roadmap discussions, and ensures alignment between Dell's offerings and Accenture's internal edge, data center, and infrastructure modernization priorities.

**Key Relationships**

* Global IT Edge Compute
* Global IT IMS Leadership
* Global IT Strategy, Architecture and Innovation
* Accenture Dell Account Management Team

**Key Responsibilities**

**Dell Account \& Relationship Management**

* Own and manage the day\-to\-day relationship with Dell account contacts, acting as the primary point of contact for account\-level matters.
* Coordinate commercial discussions, including hardware pricing, licensing tiers, and contract matters, escalating decisions appropriately.
* Track and follow up on outstanding commercial items (e.g. hardware pricing, licensing tier decisions) and ensure resolution within agreed timelines.
* Support business review cycles and executive\-level engagements with Dell stakeholders.

**Internal Accenture Liaison**

* Act as the internal conduit between Dell and relevant Accenture stakeholders across Global IT, infrastructure, and edge teams.
* Support cross\-functional coordination on active workstreams, ensuring Dell\-related dependencies are tracked and communicated.
* Prepare and maintain materials (briefings, status updates) that keep internal stakeholders aligned on Dell\-related decisions and timelines.
* Flag unresolved decisions and dependencies proactively rather than allowing them to surface unaddressed to senior stakeholders.

**Product Roadmap Input \& Liaison**

* Gather and relay Dell product roadmap information relevant to Accenture's edge and infrastructure strategy.
* Provide structured input from Accenture's perspective into Dell's product planning where relationship and process allow.
* Support development of outcomes\-led, exec\-ready materials on edge infrastructure topics, translating technical detail appropriately for the audience.


Remote with with air travel associated with role 5 times a year (e.g. Conference, meetings)


  

**Here's What You Will Need**

* Minimum 5\+ years of experience in account management, partner/vendor management, or a similar relationship\-facing role, ideally with a major hardware/infrastructure vendor (e.g. Dell).
* Minimum 3\+ years of experience managing or coordinating complex, multi\-stakeholder commercial engagements, including contract governance or procurement processes.
* Minimum 3\+ years of experience with data center, edge computing, or hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI) concepts.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate's Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience.)

* Prior experience working within or alongside a major enterprise IT function or shared services environment.

new_jobs.description:
Trusted empowers the healthcare workforce with technology\-first solutions to optimize the clinical workforce. By combining our AI\-powered staffing platform with dynamic labor marketplaces, we help leading employers automate the matching and fulfillment of clinical staff\-driving down labor costs and reducing administrative burden. Our mission, to help people everywhere get care, has support from top institutional investors such as Craft Ventures, Felicis Ventures, Stepstone, and Founder Collective as well as healthcare innovators like Texas Medical Center, Mercy Health, Intermountain Ventures, and Town Hall Ventures.

**What we're looking for:**


You will use your direct experience as a Recruiter or Account Manager in the Travel Nursing Industry to serve as a partner and key collaborator with our clients to understand their staffing needs. You will proactively solve problems, fill open jobs, and ultimately grow these strategic relationships to maintain and expand our business. The Account Manager will take initiative, setting objectives and creating actionable plans to deliver results. You will be a resourceful, solution oriented problem\-solver, expertly navigating areas such as how and when jobs are posted, upcoming projects or staffing challenges, what the job submission requirements are, and the interview and offer process cadence. You will remove barriers where possible and work collaboratively with the product and Nurse Advocate teams to increase our submission\-to\-offer rate. The Account Manager will be the day\-to\-day relationship support required to place and retain Clinicians.

**Your responsibilities:**

* Maintain trusted relationships with assigned clients, resulting in a 100% retention rate of current and future accounts.
* Meet assigned targets for growth.
* Develop new relationships that result in successful additions to our client roster.
* Gather and track feedback from clients and create reports on the health of relationships and opportunities for improvement.
* Collaborate with leadership on the Nurse Advocate team to improve standing with clients through higher quantity and quality of placements.
* Proactively identify and offer solutions to barriers for growth in our accounts and placements.

**Who you are:**

* **Strategic\-thinker.** You anticipate future trends, helping the team to understand and use complex analyses to achieve goals. You clearly distinguish and leverage the organization’s key differentiators, incorporating them into a solid long\-term strategy. You are highly alert to the future, developing hypotheses and enabling their team to address change, tackle challenges and capture new possibilities. You see the big picture in a relationship and know how the little things you do today to provide value can create big things down the road.
* **Customer\-focused.** You champion the needs of clients, helping team members deepen insight into customer needs. You have a long\-term understanding of client needs, building roadmaps with measurable outcomes that address current and anticipated problems.
* **Influencing \& Persuading.** You make it a priority to broker relationships and forge connections that contribute to others success and advance Trusted's goals.
* **Personable and reliable.** You can create and grow relationships with key stakeholders by providing value and meeting their needs in order to grow these relationships.

**You have:**

* 3 or more years of experience in healthcare staffing with direct experience working with RNs, either in Account Management or Recruitment, preferably at a high\-growth startup and/or a healthcare or staffing company.
* Experience in building and maintaining strategic relationships and growing a book of business with RNs through excellent presentation and communication skills with the ability to hold challenging conversations.
* Knowledge and understanding of the healthcare staffing landscape and buyers (VMS/MSP/Direct).
* Knowledge of compliance criteria and Joint Commission requirements for RN professions.
* Worked cross\-functionally and enjoy working as a team to achieve a goal.
* A High School Diploma is required, Associate's or Bachelor's Degree preferred.

**We offer:**

* Paid vacation \& sick time, paid family leave, and flexible work hours
* Employer\-paid health insurance, vision, and dental
* Employer\-paid life insurance
* Monthly cell phone reimbursement
* Employer\-sponsored 401k
* Variable compensation plan

*This is a fully remote position.*

*Trusted Health provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants will be considered regardless of an individual’s race, color, sex, gender identity or expression, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local laws. If you cannot submit your application due to a disability, please email hello@trustedhealth.com; we will reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities to the extent required by applicable law.*

new_jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Field Sales Representatives at AT\&T are driven to connect – every interaction is an opportunity to introduce the latest technology and services, thriving on the challenge to make your sales goals happen. With uncapped commission potential, your career and the rewards that come with it are within reach. Enjoy uncapped commission potential as a Field Sales Representative, with top earners having the opportunity to make $100,000\.


Our new Field Sales Representatives earn between $62,900 to $100,000, including the salary and our uncapped commission opportunities. Individual starting salary within this range may depend on geography, experience, expertise, and education/training. Salary range is dependent on if all sales goals are met and/or exceeded.


You’ll be the face and voice of AT\&T to your customers, working independently to deliver personalized sales interactions at scheduled appointments provided to you. * You’ll connect with our existing customers daily. AT\&T will provide scheduled appointments, giving you the opportunity to engage with warm prospects effectively.
* You’ll use strong negotiation and communications skills – you know how to make a smooth pivot, and are highly motivated to get it right and make the sale

* **1\+ years of commission sales and outside sales experience highly preferred**
* Demonstrated success in commission sales and achieving sales targets
* Proficient in upselling techniques that enhance customer value and satisfaction
* Strong verbal communication skills with an ability to build rapport quickly
* Maintain a valid driver’s license—be ready to drive, as we provide a company vehicle for **official business use only**

new_jobs.title: Business Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
At Coram AI, we’re reimagining video security for the modern world. Our cloud\-native platform uses computer vision and AI to help businesses stay safe, make smarter decisions, and move faster; from real\-time alerts to seamless clip sharing and multi\-site visibility.


You’ll be joining an ambitious, fast\-moving team that values clarity, craftsmanship, and impact. Every person here has a voice, ships meaningful work, and helps shape how AI can make the world safer and more connected.

**The role:**


Coram AI is hiring for our next cohort of Business Development Representatives to join our growing sales team. This is an entry\-level technology sales role designed for ambitious early\-career professionals looking to build a career in AI, SaaS, and B2B sales.

  

Our accelerated BDR program combines the best parts of a Business Development Representative (BDR), Marketing Development Representative (MDR), and Account Executive role. You'll work directly with experienced Account Executives on live deals, build and own pipeline through outbound prospecting, develop your sales skills, and work toward promotion into a full\-cycle Account Executive role within 6 months, compared with the traditional 1–2 year SDR\-to\-AE path. You'll learn how to prospect, qualify opportunities, run sales conversations, build pipeline, and sell Coram AI's physical security platform to businesses across the U.S.

  

Our second Fall 2026 cohort will start on November 2nd.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Build and qualify pipeline through targeted, strategic prospecting
* Partner with senior AEs on live deals, from discovery to close
* Participate in and help deliver product demos to prospects and partners
* Understand and uncover customer needs and business problems to effectively communicate how Coram can solve them
* Master Coram’s platform and learn how to sell value
* Consistently outperform assigned goals and earn your promotion to a full\-cycle Account Executive title
* Ability to understand complex business environments and uncover customer issues, process problems, and translate need into business opportunities.

 **Skills and qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Associate's degree, or relevant working experience
* We’re especially interested in college athletes and others with highly competitive backgrounds (military, performing arts, debate, high‑level competition, entrepreneurship, etc.) but this is not a requirement to apply
* A strong work ethic with a focus on winning the right way
* Motivation to win and a willingness to out‑prepare and out‑work your competition
* Intrinsically\-driven with the ability to takes initiative by default
* Coachable and curious mindset with the ability to ask questions, take feedback, and apply it to your work
* Resilient in challenging and fast\-paced environments
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English
* Ability to work in an onsite environment

 **What we offer:**

* Competitive compensation package which includes annual base salary of $60,000 \+ variable compensation of $10,000
* Clear promotion path from Associate Account Executive to full\-cycle Account Executive within 6 months
* Opportunity to relocate into any of our US offices (SLC, AZ, NYC, or ATL)
* Flexible paid time off and 10 paid holidays
* Daily team breakfast and dinner, and regular team off\-sites
* The latest Apple products and unlimited tech stack (Claude, Nooks, Clay, Instantly, etc.)
* Free onsite EV charging \+ commuter stipend
* 100% Employer\-paid medical, dental, vision, and base life insurance
* 401(k) with both Traditional and Roth options
* Early\-stage equity in a rapidly growing company
* Referral bonuses

  

We're on a mission to transform a $50B\+ legacy industry by bringing the power of cutting\-edge multimodal LLMs and computer vision to real\-world security and operations. From firearm detection to intelligent access control, our AI\-native platform turns every camera and sensor into a smart system that enhances safety, efficiency, and awareness.


Founded by Ashesh Jain (ex\-Lyft Level 5, PhD Cornell) and Peter Ondruska (ex\-Lyft, PhD Oxford), Coram AI is backed by Ansa Capital, Battery Ventures, Mosaic, 8VC and Up Partners, have raised over $65M, and were named to the CB Insights AI 100 as one of the most promising AI companies in the world. If you're excited to work on mission\-critical AI that makes an impact in the real world, we’d love to meet you.
